common_errors: Calculating buoyant force using the object's total volume instead of immersed volume
Incorrect sign for buoyant force direction
Ignoring buoyant force application when object floats at constant depth

top_down_rules.title: Check Pressure at Fluid Surface
top_down_rules.description: In fluid statics, the pressure at the surface of a fluid is equal to the atmospheric pressure unless additional forces are applied (e.g., surface tension effects).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure surface pressure is equal to atmospheric pressure unless surface tension or external forces are explicitly considered. Verify that the problem context justifies any deviations.
common_errors: Confusing surface pressure with pressure at a depth
Neglecting significant surface tension effects in small scales

top_down_rules.title: Correct Usage of Coordinate Systems in Fluid Statics
top_down_rules.description: Typically, in fluid statics problems, a coordinate system is established with 'upward' as positive z-axis. This affects the interpretation of forces and pressure gradients.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify the correct orientation of coordinate systems and ensure that pressure increases in the downward direction with depth. Confirm that all forces and gradients are consistent with the chosen coordinate system.
common_errors: Mixing up sign conventions for pressure gradients
Defining inconsistent coordinate systems, leading to calculation errors

top_down_rules.title: Verify Assumption of Incompressibility
top_down_rules.description: The equations governing fluid statics assume incompressible fluid dynamics, meaning the fluid density does not change with pressure or depth under normal static conditions.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check that incompressibility is valid for the fluid in question (e.g., water) and not assumed for compressible fluids like gases. For compressible fluids, verify that density variations are accounted for.
common_errors: Applying fluid static principles to compressible fluids without adjusting density
Misapplying incompressibility assumption in variable density scenarios

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Dimensional Consistency in Fluid Statics
top_down_rules.description: All equations in fluid statics must obey dimensional consistency, ensuring calculations of pressure and force yield units consistent with pascal (Pa) and newton (N) respectively.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify units in pressure calculations: [Pa] = [kg/m^3][m/s^2][m] = [N/m^2]. Ensure that all unit conversions are correctly applied, particularly for density and gravitational acceleration.
common_errors: Using incorrect units for density, such as grams instead of kilograms
Inconsistent unit conversion leading to erroneous pressure/force values

top_down_rules.title: Check Conditions for Floating Object Equilibrium
top_down_rules.description: For an object floating in equilibrium on a fluid surface, the buoyant force equals the gravitational force acting on the object.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure equilibrium condition: F_buoyant = F_gravity. Verify that the object's weight is balanced by the buoyant force and account for partial immersion effects for non-uniform objects.
common_errors: Ignoring partial immersion effects for non-uniform objects
Miscalculating buoyant force due to incorrect fluid density

top_down_rules.title: Account for Surface Tension Effects in Small-Scale Fluid Statics
top_down_rules.description: In small-scale fluid systems, surface tension can significantly affect pressure and force calculations, particularly at interfaces between fluids or between a fluid and a solid.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that surface tension effects are included when dealing with small-scale systems or interfaces. Ensure that the Young-Laplace equation is applied where appropriate: ΔP = 2γ/R, where γ is surface tension and R is the radius of curvature.
common_errors: Neglecting surface tension effects in small-scale systems
Incorrect application of the Young-Laplace equation

experience_rules.topic: Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 指数衰减场受力一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 物理场满足 z(x) ∝ exp(-x/Lc) 形式
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证最终受力公式是否保留 exp(-L/Lc) 的特征项，若结果不含指数项或衰减常数不匹配则存在逻辑错误。

experience_rules.topic: Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 跨步骤条件引用完整性
experience_rules.trigger: 题目出现“under the conditions set out in Task No. X”等引用表述时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须识别并代入前序任务的已知数值或物理状态（如密度比、平衡位置），严禁仅进行抽象代数推导而不给出数值解。

experience_rules.topic: Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 毛细力相互作用建模
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及两个浮体间的相互作用力且给出液面变形方程 z(x)
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否通过势能梯度 F = -dU/dL 计算，且势能 U 应包含浮体在对方造成的液面变形场中的重力势能改变（ΔU = mgΔz）。

experience_rules.topic: Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 球体浮力建模对称性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及球体或球冠在液体中浮动并要求计算露出/浸入高度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查浸入高度h_sub与露出高度h_air之和是否等于球体直径2R，并确认体积公式中的高度参数与物理实际对应。

top_down_rules.title: Check static friction force doesn't exceed maximum value
top_down_rules.description: Static friction force must always be less than or equal to the maximum static friction force, which is determined by the coefficient of static friction (μ_s) and the normal force (N): f_s ≤ μ_s * N.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the calculated static friction force is less than or equal to μ_s * N. If the object is on the verge of motion, f_s = μ_s * N. Ensure that the object is stationary when applying this rule.
common_errors: Using the coefficient of kinetic friction instead of static friction
Exceeding the maximum static friction force
Misidentifying whether the object is in static equilibrium or moving

top_down_rules.title: Ensure kinetic friction formula is correctly applied
top_down_rules.description: Kinetic friction force is always equal to μ_k * N, where μ_k is the coefficient of kinetic friction and N is the normal force. This applies only when the object is in motion.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that f_k = μ_k * N is applied only when relative motion exists between the surfaces. Confirm that μ_k is used instead of μ_s for moving objects.
common_errors: Using μ_s instead of μ_k for moving objects
Applying kinetic friction when the object is stationary
Forgetting the normal force component in inclined systems

top_down_rules.title: Confirm correct calculation of normal force
top_down_rules.description: The normal force is the perpendicular reaction force exerted by a surface. On a flat surface, it equals the weight of the object (mg) if no other vertical forces are present. On an inclined plane, N = mg * cos(θ).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the normal force is calculated based on the correct orientation of the surface and any additional vertical forces. Ensure that the angle of inclination and any applied vertical forces are accounted for.
common_errors: Ignoring the angle of inclination in calculations
Not accounting for additional vertical forces (e.g., applied forces, tension)
Assuming normal force always equals weight

top_down_rules.title: Ensure consistent coordinate system and sign conventions
top_down_rules.description: Coordinate systems should be defined clearly, with consistent sign conventions for forces and displacements. For inclined planes, axes are typically aligned parallel and perpendicular to the incline.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check that all forces, accelerations, and displacements use a consistent coordinate system and sign convention throughout the problem. Verify that the chosen coordinate system aligns with the problem's geometry.
common_errors: Inconsistent sign for friction or gravitational components
Misalignment of coordinate axes with incline
Switching between coordinate systems mid-solution

top_down_rules.title: Verify correct sign for work done by friction
top_down_rules.description: Work done by friction is negative if it opposes motion and positive if it aids motion. The work is calculated as W = f * d * cos(θ), where θ is the angle between friction force and displacement.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the sign of work done by friction matches the relative direction of friction force and displacement. Confirm that the displacement component parallel to the force is used in calculations.
common_errors: Assigning incorrect sign to work done by friction
Assuming friction always opposes motion without checking directions
Using displacement instead of the component parallel to force

top_down_rules.title: Ensure friction models are applied within validity range
top_down_rules.description: Friction models (static and kinetic) are approximations. Static friction applies only when there is no relative motion, and kinetic friction applies only when motion occurs relative to the surface.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that static friction is used only for stationary cases and kinetic friction for moving cases. Ensure μ values are realistic (0 ≤ μ ≤ 1 in most cases).
common_errors: Using friction formulas outside their applicable range
Assigning unrealistic values to coefficients of friction
Confusing static and kinetic friction conditions

top_down_rules.title: Check dimensional consistency of friction and contact force equations
top_down_rules.description: Friction force (f) and normal force (N) must have dimensions of force [M·L/T²], and coefficients of friction (μ_s, μ_k) are dimensionless.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that units in all friction-related equations are consistent and result in proper force units. Verify that coefficients of friction are dimensionless.
common_errors: Using coefficients of friction with dimensions
Incorrect unit conversions for normal force or weight
Mixing incompatible units in calculations

top_down_rules.title: Verify geometric constraints on inclined plane problems
top_down_rules.description: For inclined planes, the components of weight are mg*sin(θ) along the incline and mg*cos(θ) perpendicular to the incline. These must align with the coordinate system.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check that weight components are resolved correctly using the incline angle and are consistent with the chosen coordinate system. Ensure that sine and cosine are not swapped.
common_errors: Swapping sine and cosine in weight components
Ignoring the angle of inclination in force components
Misapplying trigonometric functions to calculate forces

top_down_rules.title: Verify smooth transition between static and kinetic friction
top_down_rules.description: When an object transitions from rest to motion, the static friction force reaches its maximum value (f_s = μ_s * N) before kinetic friction (f_k = μ_k * N) takes over.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the transition from static to kinetic friction is handled correctly. Verify that f_s does not exceed μ_s * N and that f_k is applied immediately after motion begins.
common_errors: Allowing static friction to exceed its maximum value during transition
Failing to switch to kinetic friction once motion starts
Using inconsistent friction values during the transition

top_down_rules.title: Verify Universal Law of Gravitation Formula
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the formula F = G * (m1 * m2) / r^2 is correctly applied to calculate the gravitational force between two masses.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the gravitational force F between two masses m1 and m2 is calculated using the formula F = G * (m1 * m2) / r^2, where r is the distance between the masses. Verify that G is the gravitational constant and has the correct value and units.
common_errors: Using incorrect formula for gravitational force
Confusing r (distance) with other lengths
Neglecting the inverse square dependence on distance
Using incorrect value or units for G

top_down_rules.title: Validate Kepler's First Law of Elliptical Orbits
top_down_rules.description: Confirm that the trajectory of a planet follows an elliptical orbit with the sun at one of the focal points.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the orbit is described as elliptical with the sun at one focus, conforming to Kepler's First Law. Ensure that the ellipse's parameters (semi-major axis, semi-minor axis, and eccentricity) are correctly defined.
common_errors: Assuming circular orbits instead of elliptical
Misplacing the sun not at a focal point
Inaccurate identification of the orbit's major/minor axes
Incorrect calculation of eccentricity

top_down_rules.title: Validate Kepler's Second Law of Equal Areas
top_down_rules.description: Confirm that a line joining a planet and the sun sweeps out equal areas in equal times, indicating variable orbital speed.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check the description of constant areal velocity, ensuring equal area is swept in equal time intervals. Verify that the planet's speed is higher when closer to the sun and lower when farther away, consistent with the law.
common_errors: Assuming constant speed rather than variable speed
Misinterpretation of equal areas over unequal times
Incorrectly visualizing the areas swept
Neglecting the relationship between speed and distance from the sun

top_down_rules.title: Check Kepler's Third Law of Planetary Motion
top_down_rules.description: Ensure the square of a planet's orbital period is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis of its orbit.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if the relation T^2 = k * a^3 holds for orbital period T and semi-major axis a, where k is the proportionality constant. Ensure the correct units are used for T and a.
common_errors: Neglecting the proportionality constant
Confusion between period and frequency
Using wrong units for period and semi-major axis
Ignoring the dependence of k on the central mass

top_down_rules.title: Check Gravitational Force Direction and Sign
top_down_rules.description: Ensure gravitational force vectors are directed towards the center of mass, reflecting the attractive nature of gravity.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if force vectors are directed inwardly towards the body exerting gravitational force, with negative sign in radial coordinates indicating attraction. Confirm that the vector representation is consistent with the coordinate system used.
common_errors: Using incorrect sign for attractive force
Considering forces as repulsive
Mistakes in vector direction
Inconsistent vector representation in different coordinate systems

top_down_rules.title: Verify Coordinate System Use for Gravitation
top_down_rules.description: Ensure calculations use consistent coordinate systems, commonly polar or spherical coordinates for planetary motion analysis.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check uniform application of coordinate systems ensuring consistency in distance (r), angles (theta), and orientation. Verify that transformations between coordinate systems, if used, are correctly applied.
common_errors: Inconsistent application of coordinate systems
Mixing Cartesian and Polar coordinates incorrectly
Errors in angular component assignment
Incorrect transformations between coordinate systems

top_down_rules.title: Check Dimensional Consistency in Gravitational Calculations
top_down_rules.description: Verify that all terms and quantities in relevant equations have consistent and correct units and dimensions.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure each physical quantity adheres to dimensional consistency principle and proper unit usage, e.g., [F] = [MLT^-2], [G] = [L^3M^-1T^-2]. Check for unit conversions where necessary.
common_errors: Incorrect or inconsistent units for force and gravitational constant
Misalignment in units of distance and mass
Overlooking unit conversions in physics problems
Using inconsistent units across different terms in the equation

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Conditions of Gravitational Field Validity
top_down_rules.description: Confirm the applicability of gravitational laws assuming point masses and non-relativistic speeds when calculating gravitational interaction.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify the assumption of point-like masses and ignore relativistic effects unless specified otherwise. Ensure that the gravitational field is calculated under conditions where Newtonian mechanics is valid.
common_errors: Applying gravitational laws to non-point masses without adjustments
Ignoring relativistic corrections where necessary
Assuming universal applicability without checking validity conditions
Using Newtonian mechanics in relativistic scenarios without justification

top_down_rules.title: Verify Gravitational Potential Energy Formula
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the formula U = -G * (m1 * m2) / r is correctly applied to calculate gravitational potential energy between two masses.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the gravitational potential energy U between two masses m1 and m2 is calculated using the formula U = -G * (m1 * m2) / r, where r is the distance between the masses. Verify the negative sign indicating the attractive nature of gravity.
common_errors: Using incorrect formula for gravitational potential energy
Neglecting the negative sign in the formula
Confusing r (distance) with other lengths
Using incorrect value or units for G

experience_rules.topic: Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 天体运动幂律关系判定
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求确定轨道物理量（如ω, T, v）与半径 R 的幂次关系 p 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 建立万有引力等于向心力方程 GMM/R² = m·R·ω²，通过两端 R 的指数合并位移项，提取 ω ∝ R^(p) 中的 p 值。

top_down_rules.title: Verify Impulse-Momentum Theorem Application
top_down_rules.description: The impulse-momentum theorem states that the change in momentum of an object (Δp) is equal to the impulse (F_net * Δt) applied to it. This applies when forces act over a specific time interval.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if Δp (m*v_final - m*v_initial) equals F_net * Δt, ensuring all quantities are correctly calculated and vector directions are considered.
common_errors: Incorrect calculation of Δp by missing one of the velocity terms.
Forgetting to consider the force as a vector, leading to incorrect direction.
Using average force instead of net force.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Momentum Conservation in Isolated Systems
top_down_rules.description: Momentum is conserved in an isolated system where no external forces act. The total momentum before interaction equals the total momentum after interaction.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if Σp_initial = Σp_final for all objects involved in the system, ensuring vector components are handled correctly.
common_errors: Forgetting to include all objects in the system.
Misidentifying forces as external when they are internal.
Incorrectly handling vector components of momentum.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Correct Sign Conventions for Momentum and Forces
top_down_rules.description: Momentum and force are vector quantities. The choice of a coordinate system determines the sign of these quantities. Consistent use of sign convention is crucial.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if momentum (m*v) and impulse (F_net * Δt) have signs consistent with the chosen coordinate system, and ensure all vector components are correctly signed in multi-dimensional problems.
common_errors: Using inconsistent sign conventions for velocity and force.
Assigning incorrect signs to momentum components in 2D or 3D problems.

top_down_rules.title: Check Constraints for Elastic Collisions
top_down_rules.description: In an elastic collision, both momentum and kinetic energy are conserved. This constraint applies only when no energy is lost to deformation, heat, or other mechanisms.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if both Σp_initial = Σp_final and ΣKE_initial = ΣKE_final hold true, and confirm that no energy is lost to non-conservative forces.
common_errors: Conserving only momentum and neglecting kinetic energy conservation.
Incorrectly assuming a collision is elastic when energy dissipation is evident.

top_down_rules.title: Check Constraints for Perfectly Inelastic Collisions
top_down_rules.description: In a perfectly inelastic collision, momentum is conserved but kinetic energy is not. The colliding bodies stick together after collision.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if Σp_initial = Σp_final and confirm that the final velocities of colliding objects are equal, ensuring proper calculation of kinetic energy loss.
common_errors: Forgetting that the final velocities of the objects must be equal.
Incorrectly calculating loss of kinetic energy.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Dimensional Consistency of Impulse and Momentum Equations
top_down_rules.description: The quantities in impulse and momentum equations must have consistent units and dimensions. Impulse has the same dimensions as momentum (ML/T).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that F_net * Δt and m*v have consistent units (e.g., kg·m/s), and verify that all unit conversions are correctly applied.
common_errors: Mixing incompatible units for force, time, mass, or velocity.
Using inconsistent time units between Δt and velocity calculations.

top_down_rules.title: Check Validity Conditions for Momentum Conservation
top_down_rules.description: Momentum conservation only applies to isolated systems with no net external force. If external forces exist, they must be accounted for in the impulse-momentum theorem.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if F_net_external = 0 for the system. If not, apply the impulse-momentum theorem instead of momentum conservation, and ensure external forces like friction or applied forces are modeled accurately.
common_errors: Applying momentum conservation in the presence of significant external forces.
Failing to model external forces like friction or applied force accurately.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Impulse from Force-Time Graph
top_down_rules.description: The impulse imparted to an object is equal to the area under the force-time graph over the time interval of interest.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if the calculated impulse (area under the curve) matches the change in momentum (Δp), ensuring proper integration of the graph, including negative areas.
common_errors: Incorrect integration of the force-time graph (e.g., missing negative areas).
Using only peak force instead of calculating the area under the curve.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Collision Analysis in Different Frames of Reference
top_down_rules.description: Momentum conservation and collision analysis must hold true in any inertial frame of reference. Transformations between frames must preserve relative velocities and momentum.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify if momentum conservation and collision constraints are satisfied in the chosen frame of reference, and ensure proper transformations between frames.
common_errors: Failing to account for relative velocities when switching frames.
Incorrectly applying momentum conservation in non-inertial frames.

top_down_rules.title: Verify kinematic equation consistency
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the selected kinematic equation matches the given variables and unknowns (e.g., use v = u + at only when acceleration is constant).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the problem specifies constant acceleration. If yes, verify that the equations of motion (v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5at^2, etc.) are applied correctly based on the given variables and unknowns.
common_errors: Using equations of motion when acceleration is not constant.
Mixing different equations without checking variable consistency.
Forgetting to explicitly state which kinematic equation is being used.

top_down_rules.title: Verify sign conventions for velocity, acceleration, and displacement
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that all vector quantities (e.g., velocity, acceleration, and displacement) use a consistent sign convention relative to the chosen coordinate system.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the same axis direction is consistently considered positive throughout the solution. Check the signs for initial velocity, acceleration, and displacement, and ensure they align with the chosen coordinate system.
common_errors: Inconsistent sign conventions for velocity and acceleration.
Forgetting to reverse signs when changing reference frames.
Misinterpreting upward or downward motion in vertical problems.

top_down_rules.title: Check dimensional and unit consistency in kinematics equations
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that all terms in kinematic equations have consistent dimensions and units (e.g., s = ut + 0.5at^2 must have all terms with the dimension of length).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that time (t) is in seconds, acceleration (a) in m/s^2, and displacement (s) in meters for SI units. Ensure consistent units across all terms and convert units if necessary before applying equations.
common_errors: Using inconsistent units for time, displacement, or velocity.
Failing to convert units before applying equations.
Adding or equating terms with incompatible dimensions.

top_down_rules.title: Verify independence of horizontal and vertical motion in projectile problems
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that horizontal and vertical motions are treated as independent. Horizontal motion has constant velocity, and vertical motion follows uniform acceleration due to gravity.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that horizontal velocity remains constant and vertical motion follows s = ut + 0.5at^2 with a = -g. Ensure that time is the common parameter linking the two motions and that calculations for each direction are independent.
common_errors: Assuming horizontal acceleration exists when it does not.
Incorrectly coupling horizontal and vertical motions.
Forgetting to use consistent time for both directions.

top_down_rules.title: Verify relative motion equations
top_down_rules.description: Ensure the correct application of relative velocity equations (e.g., v_AB = v_A - v_B). Verify that vector subtraction aligns with the chosen coordinate system.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if relative velocity equations are applied correctly based on the reference frame. Verify the direction and magnitude of all velocity vectors and ensure proper handling of vector subtraction.
common_errors: Reversing the direction of relative velocity vectors.
Omitting the negative sign for vector subtraction.
Failing to properly account for the reference frame.

top_down_rules.title: Verify initial conditions and boundary values
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the initial velocity, displacement, and acceleration values are consistently applied as per the problem statement.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that initial values are correctly substituted into equations and that boundary conditions (e.g., at t = 0, s = 0) are consistent with the problem statement and equations used.
common_errors: Incorrectly interpreting initial conditions.
Forgetting to apply boundary conditions at t = 0 or other defined points.
Mixing up initial and final values.

top_down_rules.title: Verify validity of constant acceleration assumption
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the assumption of constant acceleration is valid for the specific problem (e.g., no forces causing variable acceleration are present).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the problem explicitly states or implies constant acceleration. If external forces vary with time or position, ensure that constant acceleration equations are not used.
common_errors: Using constant acceleration equations in non-constant acceleration scenarios.
Ignoring forces or constraints that affect acceleration.
Incorrectly assuming gravity is the only force in vertical motion problems.

top_down_rules.title: Verify kinematics in circular motion
top_down_rules.description: Ensure correct application of angular kinematic equations and relationships between linear and angular quantities (e.g., v = rω and a_c = v^2/r).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that angular displacement, velocity, and acceleration are used correctly. Check the relationship between linear and angular quantities and ensure that angular quantities are expressed in radians for SI units.
common_errors: Misinterpreting the relationship between linear and angular velocity.
Incorrectly calculating centripetal acceleration.
Forgetting to use radians for angular quantities in SI units.

top_down_rules.title: Verify time of flight calculations in projectile motion
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the time of flight is calculated correctly using vertical motion equations and that it accounts for the entire trajectory.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the time of flight is determined using vertical motion equations (e.g., s = ut + 0.5at^2) and that it includes both ascent and descent. Ensure that the correct initial velocity and acceleration due to gravity are used.
common_errors: Calculating time of flight for only half the trajectory.
Using incorrect initial velocity or acceleration values.
Ignoring the effect of initial height on total time of flight.

top_down_rules.title: Verify range calculations in projectile motion
top_down_rules.description: Ensure that the horizontal range of a projectile is calculated correctly using the appropriate equations and initial conditions.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the range is calculated using horizontal motion equations (e.g., range = horizontal velocity × time of flight). Ensure that the time of flight is consistent with vertical motion calculations.
common_errors: Using incorrect time of flight in range calculations.
Ignoring the effect of initial height on the range.
Assuming horizontal velocity changes when it remains constant.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Conservation of Linear Momentum
top_down_rules.description: In an isolated system with no external forces, the total linear momentum before and after a collision or interaction remains constant. This principle applies to both elastic and inelastic collisions.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure no net external forces act on the system. Verify that the vector sum of initial momenta equals the vector sum of final momenta.
common_errors: Ignoring external forces acting on the system
Miscalculating momentum as a scalar instead of a vector
Using incorrect initial or final velocities

top_down_rules.title: Verify Kinetic Energy Conservation in Elastic Collisions
top_down_rules.description: In elastic collisions, both momentum and kinetic energy are conserved due to the absence of energy dissipation (e.g., no deformation or heat generation).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Identify if the collision is elastic. Confirm that the total kinetic energy before the collision equals the total kinetic energy after the collision.
common_errors: Forgetting to verify if the collision is elastic
Incorrectly calculating kinetic energy (e.g., missing the 1/2 factor or squaring velocities)
Misinterpreting inelastic collisions as elastic

top_down_rules.title: Account for Energy Loss in Inelastic Collisions
top_down_rules.description: In inelastic collisions, kinetic energy is not conserved due to energy dissipating into other forms like heat, sound, or deformation. Only momentum is conserved.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Determine if the collision is inelastic. Verify that kinetic energy is not conserved, while momentum conservation is still satisfied.
common_errors: Assuming kinetic energy conservation in inelastic collisions
Failing to account for energy loss mechanisms
Incorrectly applying momentum conservation due to external forces

top_down_rules.title: Check Relative Velocity Relationship in Elastic Collisions
top_down_rules.description: In one-dimensional elastic collisions, the relative velocity of approach before collision equals the relative velocity of separation after collision.
top_down_rules.check_logic: For elastic collisions, verify that the magnitude of the initial relative velocity equals the magnitude of the final relative velocity.
common_errors: Forgetting to apply the relative velocity condition
Using incorrect signs for velocities
Confusing initial and final velocities

top_down_rules.title: Verify Application of Impulse-Momentum Theorem
top_down_rules.description: The impulse-momentum theorem states that the impulse applied to an object equals the change in its linear momentum. This is applicable in scenarios where forces act over a short time interval.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Confirm that impulse (force × time duration) equals the change in momentum (mΔv).
common_errors: Incorrectly calculating impulse (e.g., neglecting force-time duration)
Forgetting to account for direction (vector nature of momentum)
Mixing up initial and final velocities

top_down_rules.title: Check Dimensional Consistency of Momentum and Impulse
top_down_rules.description: Momentum has units of mass × velocity (kg·m/s), and impulse also shares the same units. Dimensional consistency ensures that equations involving momentum and impulse are correctly formulated.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that all terms in momentum and impulse equations have consistent units (e.g., kg·m/s).
common_errors: Using incorrect units for velocity or mass
Failing to match units of impulse and momentum
Mixing up scalar and vector quantities

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Proper Use of Sign Conventions in Momentum Calculations
top_down_rules.description: Momentum is a vector quantity, and its sign depends on the chosen coordinate system. Proper sign conventions must be maintained for accurate calculations.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that velocity components and resulting momentum values respect the chosen coordinate system (e.g., positive for rightward, negative for leftward).
common_errors: Assigning incorrect signs to velocities or momenta
Inconsistently applying the coordinate system
Neglecting vector nature of momentum in multi-dimensional problems

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Validity Conditions for Momentum Conservation
top_down_rules.description: Momentum conservation applies only in isolated systems with no external forces. This condition must be verified before applying the conservation law.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Determine if the system is isolated with no net external force. If not, momentum conservation cannot be directly applied.
common_errors: Failing to check for external forces before applying conservation laws
Misidentifying internal and external forces
Applying momentum conservation to non-isolated systems

top_down_rules.title: Determine Collision Type Before Analysis
top_down_rules.description: Identifying whether a collision is elastic or inelastic is essential for applying the correct conservation principles.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Establish whether the collision is elastic or inelastic based on the presence of kinetic energy conservation.
common_errors: Neglecting to determine if a collision is elastic or inelastic
Confusing criteria for elastic and inelastic collisions
Attempting to apply inappropriate conservation laws

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Angular Momentum Conservation
experience_rules.title: 最高点瞬时形变势能修正
experience_rules.trigger: 在摆动最高点（速度为零）发生摆长突变
experience_rules.check_logic: 此时动能为零，机械能的变化量等于重力势能的变化量 ΔE = mgΔh，不可假设 E 保持不变。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Angular Momentum Conservation
experience_rules.title: 约束性质对动量守恒影响
experience_rules.trigger: 题目区分刚性杆（Cantilever）与柔性绳（String）约束时
experience_rules.check_logic: 分析约束力方向。刚性杆可产生任意方向约束力（突变冲量），柔性绳仅能提供拉力。碰撞瞬间若绳松弛或力过质心，需讨论动量分量守恒。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Angular Momentum Conservation
experience_rules.title: 变摆长系统能量突变判定
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在径向发生位移（如站立/下蹲）且存在径向力作用
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否错误应用机械能守恒。径向位移会导致内力做功（人消耗化学能），能量不守恒；最低点通常遵循角动量守恒，最高点通常遵循势能直接修正。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Angular Momentum Conservation
experience_rules.title: 潮汐锁定同步性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目描述“潮汐隆起与连线重合”或“自转与公转周期相同”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证方程中自转角速度与公转角速度是否设为同一变量（如 ω2），且总角动量为各部分角动量之和。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Angular Momentum Conservation
experience_rules.title: 定轴转动碰撞守恒判定
experience_rules.trigger: 物体受固定转轴约束并发生碰撞时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查转轴是否存在瞬时冲量。若转轴固定，系统动量通常不守恒；若外力矩为零（力过支点），则角动量守恒。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Center of Mass and Motion of Extended Bodies

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Center of Mass and Motion of Extended Bodies
experience_rules.title: 引力散射积分对数项检查
experience_rules.trigger: 在连续介质中对引力碰撞参数 b 进行空间积分时
experience_rules.check_logic: 由于引力是长程力，对碰撞参数的积分通常产生 ln(b_max/b_min) 形式的库仑对数，而非线性项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Center of Mass and Motion of Extended Bodies
experience_rules.title: 阻力与速度成正比的位移判定
experience_rules.trigger: 物体从静止开始运动最终停止，且受阻力 f = -kv
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用动量定理积分：ΔP = I_内 + I_外。若初末动量均为0且无其他外力，则 ∫(-kv)dt = -kΔx = 0，推导出位移 Δx 必为 0。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Center of Mass and Motion of Extended Bodies
experience_rules.title: 系统内力与外力辨析
experience_rules.trigger: 描述系统内部成员受力与地面摩擦力关系时
experience_rules.check_logic: 严禁将地面摩擦力视为内力。只要系统与外界（地面）有相对运动或趋势且存在摩擦，系统总动量就不守恒。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Center of Mass and Motion of Extended Bodies
experience_rules.title: 动力学摩擦力速度依赖性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及大质量客体（如黑洞）在恒星背景中运动受到的阻力（Dynamical Friction）
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查阻力 F 与速度 v 的关系。在高速极限下，阻力应与速度平方成反比（v^-2），若出现正比关系则建模错误。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 圆柱内壁运动受力校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及物体在竖直圆柱内壁（Wall of Death）做圆周运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 校验法向力是否垂直于接触面指向圆心（N=mv²/R），静摩擦力是否垂直向上平衡重力（f=mg），而非进行复杂的角度分解。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 重力势能零点一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 计算多段运动或复杂路径的能量转化
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查方程两端的势能项是否基于同一参考平面，特别是在摆长变化后，高度h的几何表达式需重新校验。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 变摆长圆周运动受力分析
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及摆线中途受钉子阻挡导致有效摆长突变
experience_rules.check_logic: 需分段处理：能量守恒需以初始释放点为基准，而向心力方程中的半径必须使用当前瞬时有效摆长（L - d）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 隐函数求导确定交点速度
experience_rules.trigger: 两个几何图形方程随时间变化求交点运动速度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 对联立方程组 f(x,y,t)=0 关于时间 t 求全导数，利用链式法则解出 dx/dt 和 dy/dt，避免复杂的根式显式求导。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 倾斜平衡角度定义校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出重心高度h、半径R及速度v要求解倾角θ时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需区分倾角是相对于水平面还是竖直面。在考虑力矩平衡时，tanθ通常关联向心加速度与重力加速度之比（v²/Rg）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 圆周运动交点加速度简化律
experience_rules.trigger: 求解约束在固定圆周上的动点（如交点）的向心加速度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 优先确定交点在圆周上的瞬时切向速度 v，直接使用 a = v²/R 计算向心加速度，而非对坐标分量二次求导。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 摆动高度差几何一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及摆长L和夹角θ的重力势能变化时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实θ的定义基准（与水平还是竖直夹角）。若θ为与竖直夹角，从水平下摆到θ，高度差h = L cosθ。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Circular Motion and Centripetal Force
experience_rules.title: 圆周运动非平衡态校验
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在非水平面内做圆周运动（如摆动）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 严禁直接使用静力平衡方程（如T=mg/cosθ）。必须沿径向列向心力方程：T - mg cosθ = mv²/L。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Elasticity and Hooke's Law
experience_rules.title: 均匀形变体动能建模
experience_rules.trigger: 物体（杆、绳、气柱）发生均匀拉伸/压缩且一端固定或中心对称运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否建立线性速度场 v(x) = (x/L) * V_relative，并对 v²dm 进行积分，通常动能系数为 1/6 (单端固定) 或 1/24 (中心对称)。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Elasticity and Hooke's Law
experience_rules.title: 隐含几何参数消去律
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求用质量 m 和密度 ρ 表达结果，但中间过程出现截面积 A 或长度 L 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用关系式 V = A*L = m/ρ 进行代换，确保最终表达式不含有题干未要求的几何参量。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Elasticity and Hooke's Law
experience_rules.title: 能量密度体积积分法
experience_rules.trigger: 求解连续弹性体（如杆、绳）的弹性势能且给定弹性模量与应变时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否先计算单位体积能量 (1/2)*E*ε²，再乘以体积 V，并检查 V 是否通过 m/ρ 进行参数替换。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 渗流模型参数完整性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及多孔介质（porous medium）、储层（reservoir）或油气开采时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查解题过程是否包含达西定律（流量与压力梯度、渗透率、粘度的关系）。若仅使用题目给出的宏观压缩公式而忽略流动阻力参数（k, μ），则建模不完整。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 相对论流体连续性方程修正
experience_rules.trigger: 题目提及 relativistic speeds 或给出 Lorentz gamma factor γ 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查通量表达式是否包含 γ 修正项（如 nγvA），而非仅使用经典力学中的 nvA。

symbolic_hint.canonical: n_2 \gamma_2 v_2 A_2 - n_1 \gamma_1 v_1 A_1 = S

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 烟囱/管道流动边界条件判定
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及开放端与大气相通的流体流动（如烟囱、抽气机）
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须识别流体出口（通常是顶部）压力等于该高度的大气压，而非入口压力等于大气压。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 体源项累积量计算规则
experience_rules.trigger: 出现 uniform rate of injection per unit volume (α) 与总体积 (V) 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查总量贡献是否表达为 αV（积分形式），严禁将其与截面积 A 直接相乘或作为边界值处理。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 不可压缩流体一维演化建模
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及冰川、流体薄层堆积且满足不可压缩条件时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用连续性方程 ∇·v=0 结合边界条件（如底面速度为0，顶面速度为堆积率）建立速度与坐标的线性比例关系。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 流体阻力平衡模型校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及 terminal velocity 且给出阻力公式 D=1/2*C*rho*A*v^2
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否满足 mg = 1/2 * C * rho_air * A * v^2，注意区分物体密度（求质量）与流体密度（求阻力）。

symbolic_hint.canonical: v = sqrt((2 * rho_obj * V * g) / (C * rho_fluid * A))

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 伯努利方程压强项唯一性准则
experience_rules.trigger: 在应用伯努利方程 P + 1/2ρv² + ρgh = C 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查方程左侧的 P 是否已包含液面大气压。若 P 定义为液面全压，则不应再额外累加 ρgh 项作为初始势能，除非 h 是相对于参考面的高度差。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 动态演化题目的积分必要性
experience_rules.trigger: 变量随时间变化（changing with time）且要求求解特定状态所需时间
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否建立了包含时间项的微分方程并进行积分。若直接通过代数比例或静态公式求解时间，通常存在逻辑漏项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 球体几何参数一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及球形物体（spherical）的体积与截面积计算
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查体积 V=(4/3)πr³ 与截面积 A=πr² 的半径 r 是否统一，避免直径与半径混淆。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 伯努利方程与静力学压强耦合
experience_rules.trigger: 题目同时给出伯努利方程和环境大气随高度变化的静力学规律
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否区分了流体内部压强梯度（动力学）与环境大气压强梯度（静力学），避免混淆密度变量。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 多层介质等效参数建模
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及流体通过多层不同渗透率/电阻/热阻介质且流向垂直于界面时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否满足串联逻辑：总压降等于各层压降之和，且各层流量（或通量）相等。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 镜像法边界速度叠加规则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及涡旋（或电荷）在交叠垂直边界（如直角墙角）附近的运动或受力
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否引入了所有必要的镜像源（直角需3个镜像），并验证目标点处的速度/场强是否为所有镜像源（不含自身）的矢量和。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 优先遵循局部建模假设
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出具体的物理图像（如“考虑一层空气”、“偏转角ε”）而非通用术语时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否从题目定义的微元/流体层动量变化推导力，而非直接套用教科书中的标准阻力/升力系数公式。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 自由出流边界压强匹配规则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及液体向大气中稳定喷射或流出（如阀门全开）
experience_rules.check_logic: 在不计粘性的稳定流模型中，若出口直接暴露于大气，应直接设定出口截面压强 P_out = P_ambient，而非将其作为未知数求解。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 涡旋诱导速度公式一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 出现涡旋线（Vortex filament）与环量（Circulation）概念时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证单根无限长直涡旋在距离r处诱导的速度模长是否满足 v = κ / r（注意定义中是否包含2π，本题定义2πκ为环量，则v=κ/r）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 年龄/停留时间积分一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 要求计算某位置质点的“年龄”或“经历时间”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 确保年龄 τ 定义为 dt = dz / v_z(z) 的积分，且积分限与物理过程（从表面 H 到当前高度 z）方向一致。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Dynamics (Bernoulli's Equation, Continuity)
experience_rules.title: 功率极值速度幂次校验
experience_rules.trigger: 求解最小功率对应的速度 v0，且阻力包含感生项（~1/v^2）和摩擦项（~v^2）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 功率 P = D * v，若 D = a/v^2 + bv^2，则 P = a/v + bv^3。极值点应满足 dP/dv = 0 -> v0 = (a/3b)^(1/4)。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 表面张力水平分量合成规则
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及液面曲线两端受力平衡或计算水平合力 $f_x$ 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否将表面张力 $\gamma$ 乘以切线方向余弦 $\cos\theta$，并注意左右边界矢量方向导致的符号差。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 转轴力臂定义一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 计算关于特定轴（如底部、支点）的力矩积分时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实积分变量（如深度y）与力臂（距离转轴的垂直距离）的几何关系。若变量从水面起算且轴在底部，力臂应为(H-y)而非y。

symbolic_hint.canonical: tau = integral( (h - y) * rho * g * y * W, dy, 0, h )

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 双流体界面平衡判据
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及两种不同密度流体（如冰/水）在斜面上的静力平衡或不流动条件
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否通过全压强梯度（重力分量+压力梯度）为零来建立方程，而非简单的压强相等。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 浮体漏水质量守恒校验
experience_rules.trigger: 容器漏水后仍处于漂浮状态(floats)
experience_rules.check_logic: 校验浮力定律：F_buoyant = (m_vessel + m_gas + m_entered_water)g。注意进入的水产生的重力与增加的排开体积产生的浮力在数值上可能抵消。

symbolic_hint.canonical: ρg A H_sub = mg + ρg A x

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 连通孔平衡判定准则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目出现“底部小孔(small hole)”、“液体进入(water enters)”且达到平衡时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否应用了孔口内外压强相等原则。若液体静止，孔口内外压强必须一致，即 P_in = P_out = p0 + ρgH_submerged。

symbolic_hint.canonical: P_gas + ρg x = p0 + ρg h_total

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 静水压力矩公式幂次校验
experience_rules.trigger: 计算矩形截面静水压力对底部的力矩时
experience_rules.check_logic: 压力随深度线性增加(y^1)，力臂随深度线性减小(h-y)，积分后结果应正比于h^3，且系数通常为1/6而非1/3。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 微分方程特征根匹配
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出 y'' = ay 的通解形式且 a > 0 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证解中指数项的系数是否严格对应 sqrt(a)，并根据物理收敛性（如衰减要求）直接剔除发散项（e^{sqrt(a)x}）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 无穷远边界基准对齐
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及液面形状、势能分布或场强分布且存在“far away”描述时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查函数在自变量趋于无穷大时的极限值是否符合物理基准（通常为0），若不符合需重新审视积分常数的确定。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Fluid Statics (Buoyancy, Pressure in Fluids)
experience_rules.title: 密度差系数s的物理一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 要求求解形如 tan β = s tan α 的比例系数
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证s是否由相关介质的密度比（通常涉及 Δρ/ρ）构成，而非引入无关的底座（如岩石）密度。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Friction and Contact Forces
experience_rules.title: 约束运动下的速度-位移微分转换
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在约束轨道（如杆、圆环）上运动且受阻力，求速度与位置关系
experience_rules.check_logic: 使用 v*dv = a*ds 或 d(v^2)/2 = (F_net/m)*ds，将 ds 转化为角度元 L*dphi，确保积分变量一致。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Friction and Contact Forces
experience_rules.title: 小量近似量纲齐次性
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求保留最小阶 n 的项 (ωr/v)^n 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查最终表达式的量纲是否与目标物理量一致。若修正项含 (ωr/v)^n，则其系数必须具备原物理量的量纲。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Friction and Contact Forces
experience_rules.title: 复合运动摩擦力展开
experience_rules.trigger: 物体同时存在平动 v 和转动 ωr，且满足 ωr ≪ v 时求摩擦力变化
experience_rules.check_logic: 需对单位摩擦力矢量在平动方向投影进行二阶泰勒展开：f_x = -μg * (v + ωr sinθ) / |v_vec + v_rot|，并对角度 θ 积分。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Friction and Contact Forces
experience_rules.title: 各向异性摩擦力功的分解积分
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出分量形式的摩擦力公式 Fx = -k*mux*vx/v, Fy = -k*muy*vy/v
experience_rules.check_logic: 计算功时必须分别对分量做功进行积分：dW = Fx*dx + Fy*dy = -k*(mux*cos^2(phi) + muy*sin^2(phi))*ds，不可先求合力模再积分。

symbolic_hint.canonical: dW = -N * (mu_x * cos^2(phi) + mu_y * sin^2(phi)) * L * dphi

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 近地轨道修正项校验
experience_rules.trigger: 当轨道高度 h 与地球半径 RE 比例不可忽略或要求高精度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查公式中是否包含 z = h/RE 的修正项 (1+z)，而非直接将 r 替换为 RE。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 辐射功率量纲一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 比较不同物理机制（如动力学摩擦与引力波）的能量损失率时
experience_rules.check_logic: 确保等式两端量纲均为 [Energy]/[Time]。引力波功率 P ~ G^4 M^5 / (c^5 a^5) 具有极高幂次，系数极小，通常仅在极小尺度生效。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 引力散射偏转角系数校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及质量为M的中心天体对速度为v、冲击参数为b的粒子的引力偏转角α时
experience_rules.check_logic: 在非相对论极限下，利用冲量定理或轨道方程可得α ≈ 2GM/(bv²)。若题目给出α = k(GM/v²)/b，则k应为2。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 高纬度天体可见时长修正
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及特定纬度（非赤道）及天体在地平线上的停留时间
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用球面三角公式计算时角，考虑天体赤纬 δ 和观测者纬度 φ，而非简单的经度/时间线性转换。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 内行星最大距角几何判定
experience_rules.trigger: 计算内侧行星（如金星、水星）相对于太阳的最大张角
experience_rules.check_logic: 确认视线与内行星轨道相切，利用直角三角形 sin(theta) = r/R 建立关系，注意区分轨道半径与观测距离。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 薄壳/薄环近似阶数校验
experience_rules.trigger: 出现 R-ε 且 ε ≪ R 的几何结构计算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否漏掉了主导项。若密度在边缘不为零，质量应正比于 ε（一阶）；若密度在边缘趋于零，则需保留更高阶项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 有限质量双星逃逸判定
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出两个质量相近（非无穷大比值）的天体/航天器相互分离并要求逃逸速度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用折合质量(Reduced Mass)计算动能，或同时列出动量守恒与能量守恒方程，而非假设其中一方静止。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 引力场能量与几何关联
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出总能量E = -GMm/(2a) 或要求确定轨道几何参数
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须先通过发射点的动能和势能之和锁定半长轴a，a是仅由发射速率和位置决定的守恒量，与发射角度无关。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 天体撞击临界轨道建模
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求物体从轨道出发“撞击”中心天体且要求最小能量/速度
experience_rules.check_logic: 应建立以出发点为远日点、中心天体半径为近日点的椭圆轨道模型，而非简单的直线落体模型。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 轨道半径量级校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及近地卫星高度 h 与地球半径 R 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须校验 r = R + h 是否统一单位（km vs m），避免直接将高度 h 当作轨道半径 r 使用。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 轨道极值距离判定规则
experience_rules.trigger: 已知初速度、距离和角动量（或冲击参数），求天体运动的最短/最远距离
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须联立能量守恒 E=K+V 和角动量守恒 L=mvr_perp，求解关于 r 的二次方程，而非寻找有效势能的极值点。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 阻力与向心力比值简化
experience_rules.trigger: 已知阻力模型 F=-kv 或 F=CρSv^2 且轨道为圆轨道时
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用 v^2 = GM/r，将 a_t/a_r 转化为 (F/m) / (v^2/r) = Fr / (mv^2)，代入速度平方项可消去引力常数简化计算。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 天体碰撞变轨建模
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及卫星碰撞（完全非弹性）并要求进入特定轨道（如坠毁或近地点约束）
experience_rules.check_logic: 1. 必须包含碰撞前两物体的矢量动量和；2. 碰撞点即为新轨道的远地点（若减速）或近地点（若加速）；3. 联立角动量守恒与机械能守恒求解新轨道参数。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 冲击参数与角动量转换
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出 impact parameter (b) 和初始速度 (v)
experience_rules.check_logic: 确认角动量 L 是否正确表达为 L = μvb，并检查是否混淆了初始距离 D 与垂直距离 b 的几何关系。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 严禁凭空假设分布函数
experience_rules.trigger: 题目未给出密度、场强等随空间分布的具体函数，但要求计算积分量时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查解题过程是否通过物理定律（如高斯定理、流体静力平衡）推导分布，而非直接套用常见的二次或线性假设。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 势能零点参考系一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及多个天体引力场的能量守恒计算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否在同一方程中混用了不同参考系下的势能。通常应先计算相对于中心天体（如地球）的逃逸，再处理后续轨道转移。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 黄金代换公式一致性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出近地表面重力加速度 $g$ 和地球半径 $R$ 而非 $G, M$ 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否使用了 $GM = gR^2$ 进行代换，并确保 $R$ 为行星半径而非轨道半径 $r$。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 势能连续性校验规则
experience_rules.trigger: 计算或证明球对称分布物体（如球壳、实心球）内部的势能/电势时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查内部势能是否与边界（表面）处的势能值相等。若内部场强为零，则势能必为常数且等于边界值。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 轨道半径与海拔高度区分
experience_rules.trigger: 出现“orbital altitude”或“height from ground”表述时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查计算向心力或周期时，使用的半径 $r$ 是否等于 $R_E + h$，避免直接将 $h$ 代入公式。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 角直径与线性尺寸转换
experience_rules.trigger: 给出视角/角直径 α 且明确要求不使用小角近似
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用正弦或正切函数建立几何关系：r = d * sin(α/2)，检查是否错误使用了弧度直接乘距离。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 天文尺度合理性自检
experience_rules.trigger: 计算结果涉及天文距离（pc, AU, ly）或时间（Gy）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 对比已知物理常数：若演化距离超过星系半径（~kpc）或时间超过宇宙年龄（~13.7 Gy），需重新检查指数幂次及单位换算。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 区分行星逃逸与恒星逃逸
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求从行星表面发射并进入“日心轨道”或“行星际轨道”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否误用了太阳逃逸速度公式。进入日心轨道仅需满足相对于行星的机械能大于等于零（即达到该行星的第二宇宙速度）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 轨道衰减能量微分法
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及卫星受阻力（Drag）导致轨道高度缓慢下降（Decay）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须通过 dE/dt = -F_drag * v 建立微分方程，其中 E = -GMm/2r，严禁直接用总能量除以单圈能量损耗。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 引力轨道质量无关性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求求解‘为达到特定轨道/撞击条件所需的小行星或卫星质量’时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查方程两边的质量因子是否抵消。若m << M，轨道几何特征（近地点、离心率）仅取决于比能和比角动量，与m无关。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 椭圆轨道极值位移判定
experience_rules.trigger: 给定发射速度v0和发射点P，求轨道上某点Q到P的最大距离
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用能量守恒确定半长轴a，再利用椭圆定义：轨道上任一点到两焦点距离之和为2a。最大距离通常与两焦点连线的延长线相关。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 引力半径量级校验
experience_rules.trigger: 计算天体引力半径（Schwarzschild radius）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实公式是否为 R = 2GM/c^2。对于地球质量（10^24kg量级），其引力半径应在毫米（mm）或厘米（cm）量级，若出现米或千米量级则存在计算错误。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 极端质量极限建模识别
experience_rules.trigger: 当题目问‘质量需多大才能改变轨迹’且常规二体模型失效时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需考虑小行星质量m与行星质量M可比拟的情况（m ≈ M），此时需使用折合质量或质心参考系重新建模，而非简单代入公式。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Gravitation and Kepler's Laws
experience_rules.title: 开普勒第三定律比例简化
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出多个卫星的轨道半径和周期数据表
experience_rules.check_logic: 优先使用 (a1/a2)^3 = (T1/T2)^2 进行比例运算，而非先计算万有引力常数 GM，以减少有效数字舍入误差。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 恢复系数与高度转换规则
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在固定平面连续反弹且忽略空气阻力时
experience_rules.check_logic: 恢复系数e等于碰撞后最大高度与碰撞前下落高度比值的平方根，或相邻两次最大高度比值的平方根。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 刚体端点速度矢量合成
experience_rules.trigger: 求解刚体上某点相对于地面的瞬时速度
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否正确叠加了质心平动速度与绕质心转动的线速度，注意转动半径的方向矢量与角速度的叉乘方向。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 碰撞摩擦冲量耦合校验
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在旋转状态下撞击有摩擦的平面并发生反弹或滑动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需区分垂直冲量 J_n 和水平冲量 J_f。满足 J_f = μ * J_n (滑动) 或 J_f < μ * J_n (滚动停止)。角动量定理应使用 J_f * R = ΔL。

symbolic_hint.canonical: ΔP_x = f * Δt, ΔL = (f * R) * Δt => ΔL = R * ΔP_x

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 刚体冲量矩参考点一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 计算瞬时冲量对刚体产生的角速度变化时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须确保角动量定理中的转动惯量 I 和冲量矩 r×P 均相对于同一个参考轴（通常为质心轴）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 冲量独立性假设校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目明确给出冲量分量（如 jx, jy）作为已知量时
experience_rules.check_logic: 禁止通过“无力”等主观假设将已知冲量分量设为0，必须保留符号运算直至最后化简。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 非质心碰撞冲量矩校验
experience_rules.trigger: 物体受冲量 j 且作用点不在质心（如台边高度 h）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查角动量增量 ΔL 是否等于冲量矩 r × j。需注意力臂 r 需包含几何偏置量（如 R-h 或 h）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 平均速率与路程累积校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求计算多次反弹过程中的“平均速率（Average speed）”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须累加所有上升和下降段的绝对路程（Σ|Δy|），严禁直接使用单次循环位移或末状态位移代替总路程。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 速度矢量改变的最短时间判定
experience_rules.trigger: 已知初末速度大小相等且方向不同，求在恒定最大合力下的最短时间
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否使用了动量定理 Δp = F·t。最短时间路径对应恒定力方向，而非维持速率不变的圆周运动。Δv 应为矢量差 |v_east - v_north| = √2 * v。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 区分约束力与主动转向建模
experience_rules.trigger: 题目提到“最大摩擦力”且未限制路径形状时
experience_rules.check_logic: 对比“圆周路径（速率不变）”与“直线动量变化路径”。前者加速度方向随动，后者加速度方向恒定。物理极值通常在恒力方向取得。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Impulse and Momentum Transfer
experience_rules.title: 平动与转动独立性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及 I = kmR^2 类型的刚体碰撞动力学问题
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否错误地将垂直方向的运动学量（如 v_y = sqrt(2gh)）直接耦合到水平方向的转动方程中而缺少摩擦系数项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 震源传播路径建模
experience_rules.trigger: 题目同时给出震源深度 (hypocenter depth) 和震中距 (epicenter distance) 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用勾股定理计算震源到台站的直线距离（斜距）s = sqrt(h^2 + d^2)，而非直接使用震中距 d。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 碰撞序列边界校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目明确指定碰撞边的顺序（如先BC后AD）
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查展开直线是否依次穿过指定的镜像边界线。若直线先穿过AD镜像再穿过BC镜像，则不符合题意。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 弹性碰撞往返运动的时间对称性
experience_rules.trigger: 物体从高度 H 自由落下并与地面发生弹性碰撞
experience_rules.check_logic: 单次全过程时间为 2 * sqrt(2H/g)，上升与下降阶段在同一高度 h 处对应的时刻关于最高点对称。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 区分局部转动与质心平动
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出轮子转速 ω 和转向角函数 θ(t)
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否混淆了“轮子边缘的向心加速度”与“整车质心的侧向加速度”。前者取决于 ω²r，后者取决于整车轨迹曲率和质心速度。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 高度差计算的基准一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 计算两位置高度差 h = y_B - y_A
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须确保 y_A 和 y_B 使用相同的参考系原点和时间起点，或利用速度平方差公式。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 图表数据提取优先性
experience_rules.trigger: 题干包含“Use the data/diagram to find”或提供 Seismogram 等图表时
experience_rules.check_logic: 禁止使用“Assume”设定关键物理量，必须通过图表横纵坐标刻度读取起始点与波峰/波谷的差值作为时间项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 车辆转向运动学建模
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及前轮转向角 θ(t) 和恒定轮速 ω 的多轮车辆模型
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须基于非圆切向约束建立运动方程：v_x = Rω cosθ, v_y = Rω sinθ。侧向加速度应为 dv_y/dt 或 v²/ρ，需考虑车体坐标系与地面系的转换。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 频闪/等时采样位移一致性判据
experience_rules.trigger: 物体做周期性运动且在等时间间隔 T 的采样中位置始终相同
experience_rules.check_logic: 采样间隔 T 必须是运动周期 P 的整数倍，即 T = kP (k为正整数)。需结合运动学方程求解 H 与 T 的关系。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 无时钟定位系统变量匹配
experience_rules.trigger: 题目提及“接收机无时钟”或“需确定接收时刻”且涉及空间定位
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查未知数是否为 (x, y, z, t) 四个，方程数是否至少为 4，且方程右侧仅包含光速与发射/接收时间差的理论表达式，不应包含额外的测量偏移量。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 上抛运动对称性时间关联
experience_rules.trigger: 物体两次经过同一高度点，给出时间间隔 Δt
experience_rules.check_logic: 该点到最高点的距离 Δh 与时间间隔满足 Δh = 1/8 g (Δt)^2，两点高度差为该项之差。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Kinematics in 1D/2D/3D
experience_rules.title: 多壁碰撞镜像展开法
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在矩形区域内经多次弹性碰撞到达特定点
experience_rules.check_logic: 将路径展开为直线。若碰撞宽边n次，长边m次，则位移分量分别为(n+1)w和(m+1)l，需核验tanθ与对应边长倍数的关系。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 非弹性碰撞速度分段规则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及“完全非弹性碰撞”且包含“沿地面运动速度”或“摩擦因数”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否对摩擦因数μ进行分类讨论（滑动 vs 停止），碰撞瞬间水平冲量由竖直冲量与μ的乘积限定。

symbolic_hint.canonical: v_x = f(μ) if μ < μ_c else 0

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 刚体碰撞冲量矩守恒校验
experience_rules.trigger: 刚体与固定面发生非弹性碰撞
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须识别碰撞点是否存在约束力或摩擦力，若存在，则对该点的角动量守恒需考虑冲量矩，不能简单套用质心动能转化。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 多体叠放自由落体碰撞模型
experience_rules.trigger: 出现“两球叠放”、“自由落体”、“与地面弹性碰撞”等描述时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须拆解为两个阶段：底层物体先与地面反弹（速度变号），随后与上方物体发生相对运动的弹性碰撞，不可视为整体反弹。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 匀变速运动位移比值校验
experience_rules.trigger: 两个物体在恒力作用下从静止或初速开始做匀变速运动
experience_rules.check_logic: 在相同时间内，位移之比等于平均速度之比，对于初速为0的匀加速运动，位移比等于末速度比。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 非弹性碰撞能量单调递减性
experience_rules.trigger: 处理恢复系数 e < 1 的多次碰撞能量损失问题时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证系统总动能 E_k(n) 是否随碰撞次数 n 严格单调递减。若推导出的能量表达式随 n 增大，需立即检查速度迭代公式或符号正负号。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 分段运动高度比例校验
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在上升过程中发生完全非弹性碰撞（拾取质量）且后续上升高度已知
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证中间速度平方与高度的关系：v^2 = 2g(H0-h)；碰撞后速度平方与剩余高度关系：(Mv/(M+m))^2 = 2gh'。联立消去v后检查h与H0的比例系数。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 内力做功与相对位移关联律
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在另一运动物体上滑动并产生恒定阻力（如子弹穿木块）
experience_rules.check_logic: 系统机械能的损失等于内力（阻力）乘以相对位移（木块长度L），而非绝对位移。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 多过程动量守恒约束
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及内部物体在封闭容器内多次碰撞或相互作用时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否满足系统总动量守恒 P_total = m1*v1 + m2*v2 = const。若预测中出现单体速度随碰撞次数无限增加且不满足质心运动定理，则逻辑错误。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 弹性碰撞相对速度守恒律
experience_rules.trigger: 处理一维完全弹性碰撞过程时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查碰撞前后两物体相对速度是否大小相等、方向相反，即 v2' - v1' = -(v2 - v1)。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 等质量弹性正碰速度交换律
experience_rules.trigger: 出现两个质量相等、完全弹性、正碰（central collision）且其中一个初始静止
experience_rules.check_logic: 直接判定被碰物体获得碰撞物体的初始速度，无需列写复杂的动量与能量守恒方程组。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Linear Momentum and Collisions
experience_rules.title: 强磁场近似下的动力学简化
experience_rules.trigger: 题目强调“极强磁场（strong magnetic field）”且涉及带电体碰撞
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用磁场限制了横向位移，从而简化为一维碰撞模型，并忽略次要的相互作用力（如静电力）。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 非标准色散关系动力学
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出非二次型动能公式 K(p) 或色散关系 E(k) 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用速度定义 v = ∇_p K (或 dK/dp) 建立 v 与 p 的映射，再由 dp/dt = F 推导 dv/dt。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 各向异性/非线性加速度分解
experience_rules.trigger: 动量与速度方向一致但量级非线性相关时
experience_rules.check_logic: 加速度 a = dv/dt 需对矢量 v = (v/p)p 求全导数，注意方向导数与大小导数的耦合，不能简单套用 a=F/m。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 阻力平方项微分方程标准化
experience_rules.trigger: 物体受重力及与速度平方成正比的阻力（F_drag = kv^2）运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查运动方程是否形如 dv/dt = g - (k/m)v^2，其解析解必包含 tanh(sqrt(kg/m)t) 项，且收敛于终端速度 sqrt(mg/k)。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 小参数扰动极值对称性
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给定多个小参数（如 Kb, Ks ≪ 1）且求最大偏差角度
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用了物理系统的对称性。若参数地位对等且无额外约束，极值点常出现在 45° 或其倍数角，而非依赖参数比例的复杂函数。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 忽略微小扰动项的简化审计
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出复杂的密度分布函数但限定高度 h << R 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否直接取 h=0 处的常数值进行建模。若模型仍保留复杂分布项，可能导致积分无法解析，需检查建模简化合理性。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Newton's Laws and Free Body Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 避免无物理方程的纯数学展开
experience_rules.trigger: 在未列出物理主方程前直接进行泰勒展开或求导操作
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实是否已建立 δθ = f(θ, K) 的具体解析式。若仅写出导数符号而无具体函数，则无法通过一阶/二阶导数判别法求解。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Non-inertial Reference Frames and Pseudo Forces

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Non-inertial Reference Frames and Pseudo Forces
experience_rules.title: 物理量级常识校验
experience_rules.trigger: 计算结果涉及三角函数值或地球自转效应比例时
experience_rules.check_logic: 校验离心加速度 ω²R 与重力加速度 g 的数量级。若 ω²R/g 远小于 1，则偏角 α 必为极小值（约 0.1° 数量级）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Non-inertial Reference Frames and Pseudo Forces
experience_rules.title: 旋转流体静力平衡判据
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及旋转容器内的流体（气体/液体）压力分布或压强梯度 P(x)
experience_rules.check_logic: 建立径向受力平衡方程：dP = ρ(x) * a_n * dx，其中 a_n 为向心加速度 ω²x。验证压强梯度 dP/dx 是否等于 ρ(x)ω²x。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Non-inertial Reference Frames and Pseudo Forces
experience_rules.title: 转动参考系动力学方程标准形式校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及惯性系与转动系力/加速度转换（如Coriolis force, Centrifugal force）
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查非惯性系受力是否满足 F_rot = F_inertial - 2m(Ω×v_R) - mΩ×(Ω×r)，注意惯性力项前缀必须为负号。

symbolic_hint.canonical: F_R = m*a_i - 2*m*(Omega cross v_R) - m*(Omega cross (Omega cross r))

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Non-inertial Reference Frames and Pseudo Forces
experience_rules.title: 地球自转偏角极值规律
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及地球表面物体随自转产生的悬挂偏角（plumb line deviation）或惯性力偏角时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用 tan(α) ≈ (ω²R sin(2λ)) / (2g) 形式；极值点应在纬度 λ=45° 处，而非通过复杂的导数计算得出无理数。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Non-inertial Reference Frames and Pseudo Forces
experience_rules.title: 算子法导数转换一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 出现 (d/dt)_inertial 与 (d/dt)_rot 转换时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否严格遵循 (d/dt)_i = (d/dt)_r + Ω× 算子。二次求导必须产生且仅产生一个 2Ω×v_R 项和一个 Ω×(Ω×r) 项。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Normal Modes and Coupled Oscillations

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Normal Modes and Coupled Oscillations
experience_rules.title: 链式系统边界受力校验
experience_rules.trigger: 处理 N 个质点由 N-1 个弹簧连接的线性链模型时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查第 1 个和第 N 个质点的受力表达式是否只包含一个弹簧项，而非中间质点的双弹簧项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Normal Modes and Coupled Oscillations
experience_rules.title: 内力系统合力零约束
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求寻找系统内各质点受力 (F1, F2, ..., Fn) 之间的关系时
experience_rules.check_logic: 优先验证所有内力之和是否为零，并推导对应的质心运动状态（位移加权和为常数）。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 简谐运动位移起点一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求写出运动方程且给出初始释放点
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查方程在t=0时的值是否等于初始位移l，且导数（速度）是否为0

symbolic_hint.canonical: x(0) = A, v(0) = 0 => x(t) = A * cos(omega * t)

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 动力学参数关联检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求用位移 x 和时间 t 同时表示加速度 a 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否仅通过运动学求导（a=d²x/dt²）解题。若要求包含 x，通常需引入动力学方程 F_net = ma，利用受力分析建立 a 与 x 的显式关系。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 一维连续极限态密度判定
experience_rules.trigger: 出现“large N”、“straight chain”、“number of modes in Δk”等描述晶格振动或波动模型时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用边界条件确定k的最小间隔Δk_min = π/L，并确认模式数dN = (L/π)dk，注意区分全空间(2π)与半空间(π)的边界约束。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 势能近似项系数匹配规则
experience_rules.trigger: 将复杂势能展开为 V(x) = P + Qx² 形式时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查劲度系数 k 与二次项系数 Q 的关系是否满足 k = 2Q（基于 V = 1/2 kx² 标准型）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 弹簧系统瞬时力平衡
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及恒速拉动弹簧带动质量块的系统
experience_rules.check_logic: 弹簧伸长量应表示为 ΔL = L_initial + v0*t - x。需核实加速度表达式中是否包含该时变弹力项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 多自由度小振幅周期检查
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及小摆角、可移动基座（如小车）的单摆系统
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查等效重力加速度或有效摆长是否包含质量比修正项 M/(M+m)，确保量纲为 [L/T^2] 或 [T]。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 静动摩擦切换点受力分析
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出 mu1 > mu2 且涉及从静止/同步到滑动的转换
experience_rules.check_logic: 最大静摩擦力点 (mu1*N) 是滑动的起点而非振动的平衡位置，平衡位置由动摩擦力 (mu2*N) 决定。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 恒力场不改变简谐运动周期
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在恒定外力（如重力分量、摩擦力）作用下连接弹簧做简谐运动
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证周期公式是否仅由质量m和劲度系数k决定，不受倾角θ或恒力大小影响

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 势能函数求劲度系数规则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出势能函数 V(x) 并要求求解等效弹簧常数或简谐振动频率时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否通过势能函数在平衡点（一阶导为0处）的二阶导数定义劲度系数，即 k = d²V/dx²。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 摩擦阻尼振动停止判据
experience_rules.trigger: 计算受摩擦力作用的振子停止位置或振动次数
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否考虑了末位置回复力与静摩擦力的平衡关系（|kx| <= f），停止点通常不在原点，不能直接用总能量除以平均功。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 粘滞-滑动振子能量守恒判定
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在恒速传送带/平板上受摩擦力与弹簧力作用发生振动
experience_rules.check_logic: 振幅计算必须包含临界脱离点的弹性势能与动能之和。若忽略传送带速度u，结果必缺失动能项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 释放瞬时加速度与振幅关联
experience_rules.trigger: 题目描述“支持后释放”或“从原长释放”
experience_rules.check_logic: 初始释放点位移与平衡位置之差即为振幅 A。最大加速度 a_max = (k*A)/(M+m)。若从弹簧原长释放，则 A = Δx_equilibrium = (M+m)g/k，此时 a_max = g。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 叠放物体简谐运动受力拆解
experience_rules.trigger: 物体叠放在弹簧振子上并从非平衡位置释放
experience_rules.check_logic: 1. 整体法求系统加速度 a = (kΔx)/Σm；2. 隔离法对上方物体受力分析：N - mg = ma（取向上为正），确保弹簧力不直接出现在上方物体的方程中。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 恒定摩擦力阻尼振动线性衰减律
experience_rules.trigger: 弹簧振子系统受恒定滑动摩擦力 f=μN 作用时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证振幅是否按等差数列递减（每半周期减少 2f/k），而非指数衰减；总路程应满足初动能与势能增量之和等于摩擦力做功。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Oscillations and Simple Harmonic Motion
experience_rules.title: 耦合振动特征方程完整性
experience_rules.trigger: 使用拉格朗日方程推导耦合振动系统时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须完成特征行列式 det(K - w^2M) = 0 的求解，不能在代数代换中途停止。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Power and Energy Dissipation
experience_rules.title: 阻力做功位移积分判定
experience_rules.trigger: 已知最大高度和终端速度，求阻力做功
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否通过 $W_{drag} = \Delta E_{mech}$ 结合高度 $H = \int \frac{v}{a(v)} dv$ 的解析解（通常含对数项）来确定初始/末端动能。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Power and Energy Dissipation
experience_rules.title: 二次阻力运动状态关联
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在恒力（重力）与二次阻力（kv^2）共同作用下运动且涉及位移
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用动力学方程 $v \frac{dv}{dy} = \pm g - \frac{k}{m}v^2$ 进行变量分离积分，而非仅尝试时间积分或简单能量守恒。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Projectile Motion
experience_rules.title: 三角方程根的代入验证
experience_rules.trigger: 得到复杂的三角函数方程（如包含根号与多项式混合）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 将候选答案（如 tanθ=√2/2 或 √2）转化为 sinθ 和 cosθ 代入原方程左、右两边校验等式是否成立。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Projectile Motion
experience_rules.title: 跨越约束下的最小功求解
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求物体从静止平台“跳出”或“跨越”特定距离 R 且涉及质量分配时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需同时联立动量守恒、能量守恒及抛体运动射程公式（R = v^2 * sin(2θ) / g），最小功通常在 45 度角取得。

symbolic_hint.canonical: W = E_k_total = (1/2) * mu * v_rel^2, where mu = (m*M)/(m+M)

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Projectile Motion
experience_rules.title: 运动独立性分量匹配检查
experience_rules.trigger: 计算时间t或位移s时涉及速度分量分解
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查时间计算公式t = Δx / v_x 或 t = Δy / v_y 是否满足下标一致性，严禁跨分量计算。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Projectile Motion
experience_rules.title: 非零起点斜抛射程校验
experience_rules.trigger: 物体从高度 h 处以初速 v0、仰角 θ 抛出，求水平射程 R
experience_rules.check_logic: 使用公式 R = v0*cosθ * [v0*sinθ + sqrt((v0*sinθ)^2 + 2gh)] / g 进行代数化简，而非仅凭直觉猜测三角函数值。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Projectile Motion
experience_rules.title: 相对运动中的射程修正
experience_rules.trigger: 在可滑动的底座上进行抛体运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用相对速度分解。实际射程 R 对应的是物体相对于底座的位移与底座自身位移的矢量和。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Projectile Motion
experience_rules.title: 镜像法处理弹性碰撞轨迹
experience_rules.trigger: 物体与垂直平面发生完美弹性碰撞后到达目标点
experience_rules.check_logic: 将目标点以碰撞面为轴做镜像对称，将折线轨迹转化为等效的单一直线水平位移轨迹进行处理。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Relative Motion
experience_rules.title: 脱离瞬间相对初速度归零律
experience_rules.trigger: 描述物体从运动参考系中“松脱”、“掉落”或“静止释放”
experience_rules.check_logic: 在随动参考系（非惯性系）中，脱离瞬间物体的相对初速度 v_rel 必须为 0，而非载体的对地速度。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Relative Motion
experience_rules.title: 参考系速度合成一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求在“地面参考系”（Ground frame）或特定转动系下计算动能时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需明确基础轨道速度 v 是相对于地心惯性系还是相对于地面。若为近地轨道，先确定惯性系速度 v0，地面系速度应表示为 v0 ± ωR，动能比为 ((v0+ωR)/(v0-ωR))^2。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Relative Motion
experience_rules.title: 非惯性系相对加速度合成准则
experience_rules.trigger: 物体从加速运动的载体（如电梯、火箭）上脱离
experience_rules.check_logic: 物体相对于载体的加速度 a_rel = a_obj - a_frame。若载体向上加速a，物体受重力g，则 a_rel = g + a（方向向下）。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 约束脱离临界判定规则
experience_rules.trigger: 物体沿约束面（墙面/球面）滑动问脱离点时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否误用力矩平衡代替动力学方程。正确逻辑是：列出法向/水平牛顿第二定律，令约束正压力 N=0，并结合能量守恒求角速度。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 滚动体小振动周期修正
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在曲面上“纯滚动”且涉及“小角度振动周期”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查等效摆长 L_eff 是否包含了转动惯量修正项 (1 + I/mr²)，实心圆柱应为 3/2(R-r)。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 分层结构内外逻辑校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及 crust (壳) 与 interior/core (核/内部) 的复合体模型时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查半径定义：通常 $R_{interior} < R_{total}$。核实质量分布：$M_{total} = M_{shell} + M_{core}$。预防内外层物理属性（如转动惯量公式）混淆。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 摩擦起动纯滚动能耗判定
experience_rules.trigger: 物体从纯平动通过摩擦进入纯滚动状态（Rolling without slipping）
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须考虑滑动摩擦力做功导致的机械能损失，不能直接套用机械能守恒；应优先寻找对接触点角动量守恒的参考点。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 刚体滚动加速度公式
experience_rules.trigger: 纯滚动（rolls without slipping）沿斜面下滑
experience_rules.check_logic: 加速度 a = (m_total * g * sinθ) / (m_total + I_total / R^2)，需检查分母是否包含了等效转动质量 I/R^2 和总平动质量。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 内滚系统等效摆长校验
experience_rules.trigger: 半径为 r 的物体在半径为 R 的内表面运动
experience_rules.check_logic: 动力学方程中的几何摆长必须是质心轨迹半径 (R-r) 而非 R。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 小扰动线性化方程阶数检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求“retaining terms to the lowest order of small quantities”时。
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查方程中是否包含交叉项（如 V*theta_dot），在高速近似下，某些一阶项可能由高阶运动学约束导出，不能简单丢弃所有非线性项。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 非线性摆动时间积分规则
experience_rules.trigger: 给出 ∫csc(x)dx 等三角函数积分提示且涉及大角度变加速运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 禁止使用简谐运动线性近似。必须通过能量守恒 E=K+V 导出 dθ/dt = g(θ)，再构造 dt = dθ/g(θ) 进行定积分计算。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 外部图表引用强制检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目明确出现 'using the data of Fig. X' 或 'refer to graph' 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实解题步骤中是否提取了图表中的特定数值、斜率或截距；若仅进行纯公式推导而无图表数据带入，则判定为建模失败。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 滑动摩擦力方向一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及 rolling with slipping 且定义了底部速度单位矢量 u_hat 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 摩擦力 f_k 的方向必须与接触点相对速度 u_hat 的方向严格相反，即 f_k = -mu*N*u_hat。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 刚体接触力矩矢量校验
experience_rules.trigger: 计算地面摩擦力对球体/圆柱体的转矩时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实位移矢量（质心到接触点）与摩擦力矢量是否垂直。通常位移矢量沿法线方向（z轴），摩擦力在切向平面（xy面），二者叉乘绝不为零。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 高速旋转体稳定性建模
experience_rules.trigger: 出现“rolls at high speed”、“oscillate near vertical plane”、“stable motion”等描述刚体高速旋转稳定性的表述。
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须建立基于角动量定理（dL/dt = M）的动力学方程，考虑自旋角速度与进动/章动角速度的耦合，而非简单的质点振动模型。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 纯滚动动能比例固定律
experience_rules.trigger: 匀质刚体在纯滚动状态下的动能表达
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查总动能是否正确表示为 (1 + I/mr^2) * (1/2)mv^2，对于球体应为 7/10 mv^2。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Rotational Kinematics and Dynamics
experience_rules.title: 滚动系统总质量校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出物体由主体（如车身）和多个转动部件（如车轮）组成时
experience_rules.check_logic: 平动方程 F=ma 中的 m 必须是系统总质量（主体质量 + 所有转动部件质量），不能只写主体质量。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Torque and Static Equilibrium
experience_rules.title: 旋转曲面平衡导数关系
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在旋转曲面 y=f(x) 上任意位置均能平衡
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用虚功原理或势能驻值法：d(E_p)/dx = 0。总势能 E_p = mgy + U_elastic(x)。求导得 mg(dy/dx) + dU_e/dx = 0。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Torque and Static Equilibrium
experience_rules.title: 避免虚假几何约束假设
experience_rules.trigger: 出现多个角度变量（如θ, α）且未明确几何连接方式时
experience_rules.check_logic: 禁止直接假设角度互余、相等或存在线性比例，必须通过接触点的坐标一致性或力矩平衡方程推导角度关系。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Torque and Static Equilibrium
experience_rules.title: 多体平衡受力完整性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及两个或多个相互接触的刚体处于平衡状态时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须检查隔离体分析中是否包含了所有接触点（包括物体间接触点）的相互作用力（弹力与摩擦力），严禁漏掉内力外化后的贡献。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Torque and Static Equilibrium
experience_rules.title: 弹性环势能建模校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及弹性系数为 k、半径为 r 的弹性圆环伸长/缩短
experience_rules.check_logic: 需区分弹性系数 k 是指单位长度的性质还是整环性质。若为整环劲度系数，势能应基于周长差 ΔL = 2π(r - r0) 计算，即 U = 1/2 * k * (2πΔr)^2。

topics.topic: Mechanics / Work-Energy Theorem and Conservation of Energy

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Work-Energy Theorem and Conservation of Energy
experience_rules.title: 势能零点与初始高度一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目同时给出初始高度 z0 和初始速度 v0 求最大高度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实 v0 的定义域：若 v0 是在 z=0 处的速度，则 z_max = v0^2/2g；若 v0 是在 z0 处的速度，则 z_max = z0 + v0^2/2g。需根据题干隐含的‘initial’基准判定。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Work-Energy Theorem and Conservation of Energy
experience_rules.title: 加速度方向与受力符号一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 出现 a_max = ng 且涉及向上拉力/弹力时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查方程是否满足 F_up - mg = m|a|。若误写为 mg - F = ma 且 a 为正值，则逻辑错误。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Work-Energy Theorem and Conservation of Energy
experience_rules.title: 恒定摩擦力下弹簧振子位移衰减规律
experience_rules.trigger: 物体在水平面受恒定摩擦力与弹簧力作用做往复运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查相邻两次同向最大位移（或半周期位移）之差是否满足 ΔA = 4μmg/k（或 2μmg/k），而非通过单次能量守恒方程求解。

experience_rules.topic: Mechanics / Work-Energy Theorem and Conservation of Energy
experience_rules.title: 脱离约束临界条件判定
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出初始速度大于某一临界速度（如 v0 > vh）
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须判断物体是否脱离约束面。若脱离，最高点计算需切换为斜抛运动模型（最高点竖直速度为0，水平速度不为0且不等于初速度）。
