top_down_rules.title: Verify Conservation of Energy in Heat Capacity Problems
top_down_rules.description: Energy conservation principles require that energy added to a system equals the change in internal energy plus any work done by the system.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure the correct application of conservation laws in calculations involving heat capacity and thermodynamic processes. Verify that all energy flows are accounted for.
common_errors: Neglecting work done or changes in internal energy
Misinterpreting energy flow paths
Ignoring heat losses to the surroundings

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Valid Temperature Range for Material Properties
top_down_rules.description: Material properties such as specific heat capacity and latent heat are valid only within certain temperature ranges.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the temperature range of the problem is within the valid range for the material's specific heat capacity or latent heat. Check for deviations near extreme temperatures or phase transitions.
common_errors: Using material properties outside their valid temperature range
Ignoring temperature-dependent variations in specific heat capacity

top_down_rules.title: Verify Correct Heat Transfer Mode in Calculations
top_down_rules.description: Heat transfer can occur via conduction, convection, or radiation, and the mode must be correctly identified and applied.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the correct heat transfer mode is used in calculations. Verify that the equations for conduction, convection, or radiation are applied appropriately.
common_errors: Using conduction equations for convective heat transfer
Ignoring radiative heat transfer in high-temperature scenarios
Mixing heat transfer modes without justification

top_down_rules.title: Correct entropy calculation in the microcanonical ensemble
top_down_rules.description: In the microcanonical ensemble, entropy (S) is related to the total number of accessible microstates (Ω) by S = k_B * ln(Ω), where k_B is the Boltzmann constant. This equation applies only when the system is isolated, energy is conserved, and the number of particles is fixed.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the entropy is calculated using S = k_B * ln(Ω), that Ω represents the total number of accessible microstates, and that the units of entropy are J/K. Confirm that the system is isolated and energy conservation holds.
common_errors: Forgetting to include the Boltzmann constant (k_B) in the equation.
Using Ω as a probability instead of the total number of microstates.
Using an incorrect base for the logarithm (must be natural logarithm).
Applying the formula to a non-isolated system.

top_down_rules.title: Correct use of the canonical partition function
top_down_rules.description: In the canonical ensemble, the partition function Z = Σ e^(-E_i / k_B T), where the sum is over all microstates, is the central quantity from which thermodynamic properties are derived. This applies to systems in thermal equilibrium at constant temperature T.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the partition function is calculated as the sum of e^(-E_i / k_B T) across all microstates, that energy units are consistent with temperature (i.e., E_i and k_B T have the same units), and that the system is in thermal equilibrium at constant T.
common_errors: Omitting one or more microstates in the summation.
Using an incorrect temperature or energy scale (e.g., forgetting to convert to Kelvin).
Neglecting the negative sign in the exponent.
Applying the canonical ensemble to a system not in thermal equilibrium.

top_down_rules.title: Correct expression of the grand canonical potential
top_down_rules.description: In the grand canonical ensemble, the grand potential Φ is given by Φ = -k_B T ln(Ξ), where Ξ is the grand partition function. This is valid for systems with variable particle numbers at constant temperature and chemical potential.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the grand potential is calculated using Φ = -k_B T ln(Ξ), that Ξ is correctly derived as Ξ = Σ e^[(μN - E_i) / k_B T], summing over all states, and that the system satisfies the conditions of constant T, μ, and variable particle numbers.
common_errors: Incorrectly assuming the grand canonical potential equals internal energy.
Using the partition function Z instead of the grand partition function Ξ.
Forgetting to account for the chemical potential (μ) in Ξ.
Applying the grand canonical ensemble to a system with fixed particle numbers.

top_down_rules.title: Check thermodynamic consistency of derived quantities
top_down_rules.description: Derived quantities like energy, entropy, pressure, and chemical potential must satisfy thermodynamic consistency relations (e.g., ⟨E⟩ = -∂lnZ/∂β for the canonical ensemble).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Confirm that derived quantities are consistent with their respective ensemble relations, that partial derivatives are correctly evaluated, and that all parameters (e.g., temperature, chemical potential) are accounted for.
common_errors: Miscalculating partial derivatives.
Using incorrect ensemble relations (e.g., applying canonical ensemble relations in a grand canonical system).
Forgetting to account for temperature or other parameters when differentiating.

top_down_rules.title: Correct sign convention for energy and work
top_down_rules.description: In all ensembles, ensure the correct sign convention for energy: energy input to the system is positive, and work done by the system is negative. This is essential for correctly formulating energy expressions.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check whether energy and work terms follow the convention (e.g., in the first law of thermodynamics: dU = dQ - dW). Verify that the signs are consistent across all calculations.
common_errors: Using the wrong sign for work terms in energy calculations.
Confusing energy input with output (e.g., treating heat lost as positive).
Inconsistent application of the first law of thermodynamics.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure dimensional consistency of ensemble equations
top_down_rules.description: All derived equations in statistical ensembles must be dimensionally consistent. For example, entropy must have units of J/K, and partition functions should yield dimensionless quantities when used in logarithms.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that each term in the equations has consistent and appropriate units (e.g., temperature in Kelvin, energy in Joules, and partition functions dimensionless).
common_errors: Using inconsistent units for temperature or energy (e.g., Celsius instead of Kelvin).
Forgetting to convert Boltzmann constant (k_B) to appropriate units.
Using dimensional quantities in logarithmic expressions without normalization.

top_down_rules.title: Check validity conditions for the microcanonical ensemble
top_down_rules.description: The microcanonical ensemble assumes an isolated system with fixed energy, volume, and number of particles. This ensemble is not valid for systems that exchange energy or particles with the surroundings.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the system is isolated and that energy, volume, and particle number constraints are explicitly stated and satisfied. Confirm that no energy or particle exchange occurs with the surroundings.
common_errors: Applying microcanonical ensemble to a system in thermal equilibrium with a heat bath.
Neglecting to check if energy conservation holds.
Ignoring particle number conservation.

top_down_rules.title: Check validity conditions for the grand canonical ensemble
top_down_rules.description: The grand canonical ensemble applies to systems in thermal and chemical equilibrium with a reservoir. The temperature (T), volume (V), and chemical potential (μ) must be constant.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the system satisfies the conditions of thermal and chemical equilibrium, with fixed T, V, and μ. Confirm that the system can exchange particles and energy with the reservoir.
common_errors: Applying the grand canonical ensemble to a system with fixed particle numbers.
Neglecting equilibrium conditions with the reservoir.
Assuming variable temperature or chemical potential.

top_down_rules.title: Check equivalence of ensembles in the thermodynamic limit
top_down_rules.description: In the thermodynamic limit (large number of particles and volume), the predictions of the microcanonical, canonical, and grand canonical ensembles should converge for bulk properties.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that derived quantities (e.g., energy, pressure, entropy) from different ensembles converge in the thermodynamic limit. Ensure that finite-size effects are negligible.
common_errors: Ignoring finite-size effects in small systems.
Assuming equivalence of ensembles without verifying the thermodynamic limit.

top_down_rules.title: Verify the fundamental thermodynamic equations.
top_down_rules.description: Check the use of fundamental thermodynamic equations, such as the Helmholtz free energy (F = U - TS) and Gibbs free energy (G = H - TS). These equations connect internal energy, enthalpy, entropy, and temperature.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the expressions for F and G are correctly derived from internal energy (U) and enthalpy (H), and that temperature (T) and entropy (S) are correctly included with appropriate coefficients. Verify that the equations are dimensionally consistent and that all terms are properly labeled.
common_errors: Omitting the TS term in the equations.
Mislabeling variables (e.g., using H instead of U in Helmholtz free energy).
Incorrectly rearranging terms in the equations.

top_down_rules.title: Confirm correct sign conventions in thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: In thermodynamics, positive work done by the system and heat added to the system are considered positive. Ensure that these conventions are consistently applied when using thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that work, heat, and other energy terms follow the sign conventions in derivations and calculations involving F or G. Ensure that the signs are consistent with the first and second laws of thermodynamics.
common_errors: Using the wrong sign for work done by or on the system.
Confusing heat absorbed with heat released and applying incorrect signs.
Incorrect sign application when relating F or G to system properties (e.g., pressure or temperature).

top_down_rules.title: Check partial derivatives of thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: Thermodynamic potentials have specific relationships with system variables. For example, (∂F/∂V)_T = -P and (∂G/∂P)_T = V. These partial derivatives must be correctly applied when computing thermodynamic quantities.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the correct derivative relationships are used for the given potential and variable of interest. Ensure that the appropriate variable is held constant during differentiation and that the physical interpretation of the derivative is correct.
common_errors: Incorrect partial derivative relationships (e.g., swapping variables like pressure and volume).
Forgetting to hold the appropriate variable constant (e.g., temperature).
Using an incorrect thermodynamic potential for the derivative.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure dimensional and unit consistency in thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: Thermodynamic potentials must have units of energy (e.g., Joules in the SI system). Ensure all terms in the equations have consistent dimensions and units.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check that each term in F, G, and related expressions has the same dimensions, and that derived quantities (e.g., partial derivatives) are dimensionally consistent. Verify that unit conversions are correctly applied when switching between unit systems.
common_errors: Using inconsistent units for temperature, entropy, or pressure.
Neglecting unit conversions when switching between systems (e.g., SI to CGS).
Combining terms with mismatched dimensions (e.g., mixing energy with pressure).

top_down_rules.title: Verify validity conditions for thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: Helmholtz free energy is used in systems at constant temperature and volume, while Gibbs free energy applies to constant temperature and pressure. Ensure the conditions for applying each potential are explicitly stated and satisfied.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Confirm that the problem specifies constant temperature and appropriate constraints (volume for F, pressure for G) before using the corresponding potential. Verify that the assumptions are explicitly stated in the problem setup.
common_errors: Using Helmholtz free energy in a system where pressure is not constant.
Applying Gibbs free energy to a system with varying temperature.
Neglecting to check if the required conditions are satisfied before proceeding.

top_down_rules.title: Check maximum work conditions for free energy changes.
top_down_rules.description: Helmholtz free energy (F) represents the maximum work extractable at constant temperature and volume. Gibbs free energy (G) represents the maximum non-expansion work at constant temperature and pressure.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the work extracted does not exceed the changes in F or G under the specified conditions. Ensure that the type of work (e.g., expansion or non-expansion) is correctly identified and that the appropriate potential is used.
common_errors: Calculating work exceeding the change in free energy.
Misinterpreting the type of work (e.g., expansion vs. non-expansion work).
Applying the wrong potential for the given constraints.

top_down_rules.title: Verify equilibrium conditions using thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: At equilibrium, thermodynamic potentials reach their minimum values under the specified constraints (F for constant T and V, G for constant T and P). Check if this principle is correctly applied.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the potential is minimized at equilibrium, and that the conditions for equilibrium (e.g., ∂F/∂V = 0 or ∂G/∂P = 0) are satisfied. Verify that higher-order derivatives are used to confirm stability when necessary.
common_errors: Failing to check for minimum potential values at equilibrium.
Using the wrong thermodynamic potential for the given constraints.
Ignoring higher-order derivatives to confirm stability.

top_down_rules.title: Verify Legendre transforms between thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: Thermodynamic potentials are related via Legendre transforms. For example, G = F + PV. Ensure such transformations are correctly executed and account for all variables.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check that the Legendre transform equations are correctly applied and that all terms are included with proper signs. Verify that the starting potential and the transformed potential are consistent with the problem's constraints.
common_errors: Forgetting to include PV or TS terms in the transformation.
Incorrect sign convention in Legendre transforms.
Using an incorrect thermodynamic potential as the starting point.

top_down_rules.title: Verify stability conditions for thermodynamic potentials.
top_down_rules.description: Thermodynamic stability requires that the second derivatives of potentials satisfy specific conditions. For example, (∂²F/∂V²)_T > 0 ensures stability at constant temperature and volume.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the second derivatives of the potential are consistent with stability criteria. Ensure that the appropriate variables are held constant during differentiation.
common_errors: Neglecting to check second derivatives for stability.
Using incorrect stability criteria for the given potential.
Failing to hold the appropriate variables constant during differentiation.

top_down_rules.title: Verify PV = nRT for Isothermal Process
top_down_rules.description: During an isothermal process, the temperature remains constant. The ideal gas law (PV = nRT) is used to relate pressure, volume, and amount of substance with the constant temperature.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure the temperature is constant throughout the process. Verify that PV = nRT holds for both the initial and final states, using Kelvin for the temperature.
common_errors: Incorrect usage of ideal gas law when temperature is not constant.
Forgetting to convert temperatures to Kelvin.
Not using amount of substance in moles.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure PV^γ = constant for Adiabatic Process
top_down_rules.description: In an adiabatic process, no heat exchange occurs. The equation PV^γ = constant should be used, where γ is the heat capacity ratio (Cp/Cv).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that no heat transfer occurs (Q=0) and check that PV^γ = constant throughout the process.
common_errors: Miscalculation of γ (Cp/Cv) or using incorrect gas properties.
Not verifying the condition of no heat exchange.
Inappropriate use of PV = nRT without considering adiabatic conditions.

top_down_rules.title: Apply First Law of Thermodynamics Correctly
top_down_rules.description: The first law entails energy conservation, expressed as ΔU = Q - W, where ΔU is the change in internal energy, Q is heat added to the system, and W is the work done by the system.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Calculate ΔU using ΔU = Q - W, identifying Q and W based on the process type. Ensure correct sign conventions are used.
common_errors: Not distinguishing between work done on and by the system.
Misinterpretation of sign conventions for heat and work.
Omitting internal energy change calculation.

top_down_rules.title: Check Sign Conventions for Work and Heat
top_down_rules.description: Sign conventions dictate that heat (Q) added to the system is positive, and work (W) done by the system is positive according to classical convention.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Confirm correct sign assignment for heat and work in process equations.
common_errors: Confusing sign conventions between different textbooks or resources.
Incorrectly assigning signs for exothermic and endothermic reactions.
Ignoring sign conventions in calculations leading to erroneous energy balance.

top_down_rules.title: Validate Geometric Volume Constraints
top_down_rules.description: Certain processes involve geometric constraints. Verify volume changes conform to system constraints such as constant volume (isochoric) or variable volume.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure volume changes reflect geometric constraints. Verify appropriately for fixed or variable volume processes.
common_errors: Not accounting for fixed volume in isochoric processes.
Incorrectly assuming volume change when it is geometrically constrained.
Neglecting compatibility with experimental or real-world constraints.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Dimensional Consistency and Unit Use
top_down_rules.description: Dimensional consistency is critical. All equations must maintain unit consistency. Variables must be expressed in compatible units, e.g., temperatures in Kelvin, volumes in m³, pressure in Pa.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check equations for dimensional consistency and confirm unit conversions where necessary.
common_errors: Mixing units (e.g., Celsius with Kelvin, atm with Pa).
Neglecting unit conversions leading to incorrect results.
Confusing energy units like joules, calories, etc.

top_down_rules.title: Assess Validity of Reversible Process Assumption
top_down_rules.description: Reversible process assumptions require specific conditions. Real-world processes often deviate from this ideal. Validate applicability before enforcement.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure assumptions of reversibility align with process conditions, such as infinitesimally slow change and lack of energy dissipation.
common_errors: Incorrectly applying reversible process assumptions to irreversible scenarios.
Ignoring effects like friction or turbulence that negate reversibility.
Assuming perfect insulation in adiabatic processes.

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Planck's Law
experience_rules.title: 指数衰减多项式积分核对
experience_rules.trigger: 出现形如 x^n * exp(ax) 的定积分计算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用分部积分公式或给出的积分表，重点核查上限为无穷大、下限为0时，非零项是否仅出现在常数项（x=0处）。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Planck's Law
experience_rules.title: 分布函数全域积分校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出单位频率/波长间隔的分布函数（如u(v)）并要求总功率/能量时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否对全定义域（通常为0到无穷大）进行定积分，并验证积分变量与分布函数自变量的一致性。

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Stefan-Boltzmann Law

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Stefan-Boltzmann Law
experience_rules.title: 温室效应模型能量平衡校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及大气吸收率（alpha_vis, alpha_ir）与地表温度计算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需区分单层大气模型与直接辐射模型。若存在大气吸收，地表辐射需考虑大气向下回射，平衡方程通常形如：(1-A)S = (1-alpha_ir)sigma*T^4 + 大气贡献项。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Stefan-Boltzmann Law
experience_rules.title: 距离扰动下的平方反比修正
experience_rules.trigger: 出现距离增加/减少百分比 f 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 距离变为 r(1+f)，则辐射通量 w 变为 w/(1+f)^2。注意 (1-f)^2 仅在 f 极小时作为 1/(1+f)^2 的近似，且物理意义不同。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Stefan-Boltzmann Law
experience_rules.title: 辐射平衡微扰线性化准则
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律且温度变化量 ΔT 远小于环境温度 T 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否使用 ΔP/P ≈ 4ΔT/T 进行线性化简化，而非直接对 T^4 项进行错误的代数变形。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Blackbody Radiation and Stefan-Boltzmann Law
experience_rules.title: 有效投影面积一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 计算行星吸收太阳辐射与反射镜遮挡功率时
experience_rules.check_logic: 确认吸收项使用截面积 πR²，辐射项使用全表面积 4πR²，且反射镜面积 A 应直接对应减少的输入功率 P_in。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics
experience_rules.title: 区分循环净热量与吸热量
experience_rules.trigger: 题目问法为 'heat added to the gas' 或 'heat absorbed' 而非 'net heat'
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否将放热过程（Q < 0）的热量代入求和；若要求的是吸热量，应只累加 Q > 0 的项。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics
experience_rules.title: 绝热过程功号一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 在 Adiabatic Process (Q=0) 计算 Work Done 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查 W_by_system 是否等于 -(U_final - U_initial)。若预测中出现 W = ΔU 且未说明是 'work done on'，通常判定为符号逻辑错误。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics
experience_rules.title: 绝热容器混合内能守恒律
experience_rules.trigger: 题目出现“绝热容器”、“连接/混合”、“理想气体”且求平衡温度
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否建立 U_total = Σ(C_v * n_i * T_i) 关系，并确认 n_i 可由 PV/RT 替换以消除未知量

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics
experience_rules.title: 分子速率与温度平方根正相关
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及同种气体的 root-mean-square speed (v_rms) 比例计算
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证比例是否满足 v1/v2 = sqrt(T1/T2)，需注意温度单位必须为开尔文(K)

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics
experience_rules.title: 绝热过程体积压力关系校验
experience_rules.trigger: 出现绝热过程（adiabatic）且已知压力变化求体积变化
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否正确使用 P1*V1^γ = P2*V2^γ，并注意单原子分子的 γ = 5/3。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics
experience_rules.title: 绝热恒容系统压力守恒判定
experience_rules.trigger: 绝热容器、移动活塞分隔、同自由度理想气体、热平衡过程
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查总内能表达式 U = Σ(f/2)PV。若总体积V和总内能U不变且各组分自由度f相同，则总压强P必保持不变。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / First Law of Thermodynamics

experience_rules.check_logic: 需严格对应：p dE 为对外做功项（能级移动），E dp 为热交换项（分布改变）。计算功时注意系统对外做功与内能减少量的等价性。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Heat Transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation)

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Heat Transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation)
experience_rules.title: 冷却时间积分模型校验
experience_rules.trigger: 已知热容 C 和功率函数 P(T)，求温度变化时间 t
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须检查是否使用了 t = ∫ (C / P(T)) dT 形式。若错误使用 t = ΔQ / P_avg 或 t = ΔT / (dT/dt)，则判定为逻辑错误。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Heat Transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation)
experience_rules.title: 热学量纲一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求计算 Heat flow 或 Heat flux 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实符号J或q代表的是总功率(W)还是单位面积功率(W/m²)，并检查最终量纲是否与参考系或常数项匹配。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Heat Transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation)
experience_rules.title: 图表信息提取完整性
experience_rules.trigger: 题目提及 'Attached is a plot' 但未提供具体数值
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否通过读取图表斜率、截距或特定点面积进行解析。严禁在无数据支撑时自行虚构线性离散表进行数值积分。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Heat Transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation)
experience_rules.title: 传热模型边界条件校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及物体放入恒温介质（如沸水）的瞬态传热估算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 区分稳态导热（傅里叶定律直接应用）与瞬态传热。估算初态热流时，应考虑边界层热阻而非仅考虑物体内部结构（如蛋壳）。

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 开口容器压强平衡律
experience_rules.trigger: 题目出现“open-bottomed”或“开口容器”且处于大气中时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需确认内部压强 P 始终等于外部大气压 P_0，而非封闭系统的等容升压过程。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 混合气体摩尔质量等效法
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出湿空气或多种组分气体的质量占比时
experience_rules.check_logic: 需先计算混合气体的等效摩尔质量 M_eff = 1 / (Σ (wi / Mi))，再利用理想气体状态方程 PV = (m/M_eff)RT 求解。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 等压等容系统内能守恒
experience_rules.trigger: 理想气体在 P, V 均恒定时温度 T 发生变化
experience_rules.check_logic: 根据 PV=NkT，若 P, V 不变，则 NT 乘积为常数；结合 K=1.5NkT，推导出总动能 K 保持不变。

symbolic_hint.canonical: N_i T_i = N_f T_f \Rightarrow K_i = K_f

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 饱和蒸汽压恒定性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及等温压缩且存在饱和蒸汽的混合气体系统
experience_rules.check_logic: 需确认压缩后蒸汽分压是否仍等于该温度下的饱和蒸汽压；若体积减小，超出饱和部分的蒸汽必须转化为液态。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 封闭容器饱和蒸气压叠加规则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及封闭容器内液体加热且存在空气层时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查总压是否定义为空气分压与饱和蒸气压之和（P_total = P_air + P_sv），而非误用大气压减法。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 理想气体状态方程比例简化
experience_rules.trigger: 恒压条件下，已知初始密度和温度，求末态温度
experience_rules.check_logic: 直接利用 ρ1*T1 = ρ2*T2 关系，避免引入气体常数 R 和 压强 p 的绝对值计算，减少累积误差。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 浮力平衡质量守恒检查
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及热气球、浮体在气体中达到中性平衡
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证外部排开空气质量是否等于内部气体质量与结构质量之和：m_ext = m_int + m_structure

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 道尔顿分压定律符号一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 多组分气体混合压力计算
experience_rules.check_logic: 严防题目给定已知量符号（如p1）与待求总量符号（如p_total）发生重叠，需在建模初定义独立变量。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 单调性描述与导数符号一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 题目出现“某物理量随某变量增加/减小”或“increase/decrease with”表述时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证数学建模中的一阶导数符号是否与增减性描述匹配：增加对应 > 0，减小对应 < 0。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 饱和蒸气质量计算体积一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 计算饱和蒸气质量 m_sv 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用当前温度下的气相空间体积 V_gas（V_total - V_liquid），并结合克拉珀龙方程计算。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 分段压力比例一致性检查
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及隔板移除前后的压力变化比例计算
experience_rules.check_logic: 移除隔板后总压 P = (n1+n2)RT/V_total。若初始体积相等，则 P/P1 = (n1+n2)/(2*n1)，P/P2 = (n1+n2)/(2*n2)。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 静力学平衡下的密度梯度判别
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及大气压强、温度梯度与密度分布的综合问题
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用 P=ρRT/M 和 dP/dz=-ρg，检查 dρ/dz 的表达式是否正确关联了温度梯度 Λ 和重力项。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 等温等压气体密度正比律
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给定相同温度和压力（same pressure and temperature）比较不同成分气体密度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否满足 ρ1/ρ2 = M1/M2。若误用为反比或忽略摩尔质量变化则报错。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Ideal Gas Law and Real Gas Behavior
experience_rules.title: 质量分数求平均摩尔质量
experience_rules.trigger: 已知各组分质量分数（mass fraction）求混合气体平均摩尔质量时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证公式是否为 M_avg = 1 / Σ(w_i / M_i)，其中 w_i 为质量分数。严防将其与摩尔分数公式混淆。

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 等温大气压强指数分布校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求推导或使用随高度变化的压强公式（Barometric formula）
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查指数项是否为无量纲量，即高度h的系数是否等于(RT/μg)的倒数，且符号为负（随高度增加压强减小）。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 热浮力加速度量级判定
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及小温差引起的流体密度变化及浮力驱动运动时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查加速度是否满足 a ≈ g * (ΔT / T)，这是基于理想气体状态方程和阿基米德原理的线性近似结果。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 防止代数化简死循环
experience_rules.trigger: 模型在化简根式或分式时出现连续重复行
experience_rules.check_logic: 监控推理链中是否存在超过3次完全相同的表达式变换，若存在则判定为逻辑陷入死循环，需重新检查化简路径

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 气体分子速率量级常识校验
experience_rules.trigger: 计算常温（300K左右）下常见气体（N2, O2, Air）的平均速率或方均根速率时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查计算结果是否在 300m/s 至 600m/s 范围内。若出现 10^4 m/s 或更高量级，通常是摩尔质量单位（kg/mol vs g/mol）或 R 取值错误。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 特征高度量级常识检查
experience_rules.trigger: 计算大气标高或特征高度 h0 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 地球大气在常温（约300K）下的标高约为8km，若温度升高至425K，h0应按比例增大至11-13km区间。若计算结果偏离此量级需检查摩尔质量单位（kg/mol vs g/mol）。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 旋转流体压力梯度符号检查
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及旋转体系（角速度 ω）中的流体压力分布 p(r) 计算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查 dp/dr 的正负号：离心力方向向外（+r），压力梯度必须与之抵消或由其产生，即 dp/dr 应为正值，压力随 r 增大而增大。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 自引力系统维里平衡判定
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及自引力球对称气体（Self-Gravitating gas）的机械平衡与能量关系
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否应用维里定理 2K + Ω = 0，并结合单原子内能 U = K = 3/2 ∫ P dV，验证是否满足 U = -1/2 Eg。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 气体分子撞击率推导一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及气体分子撞击率 J 与压强 P、温度 T 的关系推导
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否正确代入 n = P/(kT) 和平均速率 v_avg = sqrt(8kT/πm)，并验证系数 1/4 * (1/kT) * sqrt(8kT/πm) 是否化简为 1/sqrt(2πmkT)

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 平均速度与末速度比例关系
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求估算（rough estimate）匀加速运动的平均速度时
experience_rules.check_logic: 确认平均速度 v_avg 是否取为末速度 v_max 的 1/2 或同量级，避免直接将末速度作为平均速度。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 分子流率公式符号一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 题目给出单位面积碰撞数 N* = 1/4 n* v_bar 并要求计算总数 N 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否满足 N = (P/kT) * (1/4) * v_bar * S。注意区分压强 P 与数密度 n 的关系，以及摩尔质量与单分子质量的转换。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Kinetic Theory of Gases
experience_rules.title: 内能与压强积分转换规则
experience_rules.trigger: 出现内能 U 与空间压力分布 P(r) 的积分关系推导
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证是否满足 U = (f/2) * ∫ P dV（f为自由度），对于单原子气体 f=3，应检查积分项 ∫ 4πr^2 P(r) dr 的系数。

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 热量段长度比例建模
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及加热曲线（T-t图）转换为热量轴（T-Q图）求线段比例
experience_rules.check_logic: 线段长度比应等于吸收热量之比 Q1/Q2 = (m*c1*ΔT1) / (m*c2*ΔT2)，需严格从图像提取ΔT，而非仅用标准100度温差。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 相变平衡放热主体识别
experience_rules.trigger: 在恒温相变点（如冰水混合物）加入低温物体时
experience_rules.check_logic: 确认热量平衡方程中，放热项应为液体的凝固潜热，吸热项应为低温固体的升温显热。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 相变功率平衡一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 计算质量流率 mu = P / L 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证功率 P 是否已扣除环境散热、流体整体升温所需显热，仅保留用于相变的潜热部分。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 区分题号与数值
experience_rules.trigger: 题目末尾出现括号包裹的数字，如 (27) 或 (15)
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实该数字是否为填空位编号或题目序号，而非物理常量或计算目标值，防止模型将其误认为答案。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 光热转换效率校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及纳米颗粒、激光照射或流体局部加热产生蒸汽的场景
experience_rules.check_logic: 需检查是否考虑了光穿透深度、颗粒吸收截面（Cross-section）以及光强随深度的衰减，不能直接假设入射功率等于吸收功率。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 区分题号标签与数值常量
experience_rules.trigger: 题目中出现带括号的数字如 (26) 或 【26】 且位于填空位置时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证该数字是否为题目序号或占位符，而非物理常量或已知条件，避免将其代入计算或作为目标参考。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 未知物性参数消元法
experience_rules.trigger: 题目未给出某物质比热容等参数，且存在多次平衡过程时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否通过建立联立方程组消去未知的物性参数（如固体比热容 C_s），而非盲目假设其等于已知物质参数。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 饱和蒸汽压冷凝量计算模型
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及空气降温除湿、饱和蒸汽压变化及冷凝水体积计算时
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用理想气体状态方程计算初末态水蒸气物质的量差值 Δn = (P1/T1 - P2/T2) * V / R，再换算为质量和体积。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 热流密度与相变厚度转换
experience_rules.trigger: 给出热流密度 J_Q、时间 t 和潜热 L，求融化/凝固厚度 d
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证能量守恒方程 J_Q * t = ρ * d * L 是否成立，注意密度 ρ 需对应相变前的物质状态

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Phase Transitions and Latent Heat
experience_rules.title: 时间单位年秒转换校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目涉及年度（year）物理量计算
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否使用了 1 year ≈ 3.15 * 10^7 s 进行量纲对齐，避免直接以天或小时代入 SI 单位公式

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Second Law and Entropy

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Second Law and Entropy
experience_rules.title: 区分等温热源与有限热容热源
experience_rules.trigger: 出现“Heat engine operates between two objects”而非“between two reservoirs”
experience_rules.check_logic: 若热源是有限质量物体，效率 η 不能直接套用 (1 - TL/TH) 常数公式，必须考虑温度演化过程。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Second Law and Entropy
experience_rules.title: 绝热过程末态压力关联
experience_rules.trigger: 出现“adiabatic piston”且一侧为“adiabatic process”时
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用 $P_0 V_0^\gamma = P_f V_f^\gamma$ 确定末态压力，并注意两侧力学平衡导致 $P_{f,L} = P_{f,R}$。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Second Law and Entropy
experience_rules.title: 变温热源最大功熵平衡准则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求“最大理论功”或“最大机械能”且热源温度随热量交换变化时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否利用全系统熵增为零（ΔS_total = 0）来确定最终状态，而非简单的能量守恒或算术平均温。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Second Law and Entropy
experience_rules.title: 恒温热库熵变计算准则
experience_rules.trigger: 题目要求计算“Heat Reservoir”或“Bath”的熵变 $\Delta S_{Bath}$ 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用 $\Delta S_{Bath} = -Q_{system} / T_{Bath}$。若系统由多个部分组成且总体积不变，应通过 $\Delta Q = \sum \Delta U_i$ 求解总吸热。

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Specific Heat and Heat Capacities

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Specific Heat and Heat Capacities
experience_rules.title: 多原子分子自由度校验
experience_rules.trigger: 计算水蒸气(H2O)、氨气(NH3)等非线性多原子气体的热容时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否错误沿用双原子分子的自由度(i=5)；非线性多原子分子在常温下自由度应取 i=6，即 Cv=3R。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Specific Heat and Heat Capacities
experience_rules.title: 混合物强度性质加权律
experience_rules.trigger: 计算混合体系的摩尔物理量（如摩尔热容、摩尔质量）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否满足 (n1*X1 + n2*X2) / (n1 + n2) 的加权平均形式，而非简单的算术平均。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Specific Heat and Heat Capacities
experience_rules.title: 变系数热量积分检查
experience_rules.trigger: 当热容 C 或比热容 c 表现为温度 T 的函数（如 C=a+bT）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用定积分 Q = ∫ C(T) dT 计算，而非直接代入 Q = CΔT，需检查积分上下限与多项式积分幂次是否正确。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Specific Heat and Heat Capacities
experience_rules.title: 多项式因式分解等价性
experience_rules.trigger: 结果包含平方差项 (T2^2 - T1^2) 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否可提取 (T2 - T1) 项以简化为平均热容形式，验证 a(T2-T1) + 0.5b(T2+T1)(T2-T1) 的提取逻辑。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Specific Heat and Heat Capacities
experience_rules.title: 混合气体摩尔热容加权逻辑
experience_rules.trigger: 计算多种气体混合后的平均摩尔热容
experience_rules.check_logic: 核实是否使用物质的量(n)进行加权平均，而非质量(m)；公式应为 (Σn_i*Cv_i) / Σn_i。

topics.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)
experience_rules.title: 两相流绝热过程建模
experience_rules.trigger: 题目提及“reversible expansion”、“equilibrium between liquid and gaseous phases”及“adiabatic”
experience_rules.check_logic: 必须使用等熵过程（s1=s2）结合干度（quality）公式计算，严禁直接套用理想气体多方过程方程 P v^γ = C。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)
experience_rules.title: 喷管流动能量守恒校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及流体在通道或喷嘴（nozzle）中的加速流动
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否正确应用稳态稳流能量方程（SFEE），动能的增加必须对应焓的减少，不可假设焓不变。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)
experience_rules.title: 绝热过程状态量微分关系校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及理想气体绝热过程（Adiabatic）中 P、V、T 的微小变化关系时
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用 P^(1-γ) * T^γ = const 求导，校验 dT/T = ((γ-1)/γ) * dP/P 的系数正负与量级

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)
experience_rules.title: 简谐振动方程正定性校验
experience_rules.trigger: 推导位移二阶微分方程 d²x/dt² = Ax 时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证系数 A 是否为负值。若 A > 0，系统将发散而非振荡，需回溯压力或重力项的线性化展开过程。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)
experience_rules.title: 分母扰动线性化符号检查
experience_rules.trigger: 出现形如 (L/(L+x))^n 或 (1+x)^{-n} 的小量展开时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查展开式系数是否与原指数符号一致。对于稳定平衡系统，增加位移应产生减小趋势的力（回复力），系数必为负。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Work Done by Gases and PV Diagrams
experience_rules.title: 等温过程功的对数一致性
experience_rules.trigger: 循环过程包含等温线（Isothermal process）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 验证等温功 W = nRT ln(V2/V1) 中的温度 T 是否与循环中其他状态点的 PV/nR 一致，并确认对数项的比例是否简化。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics & Statistical Physics / Work Done by Gases and PV Diagrams
experience_rules.title: PV图坐标数值化校验
experience_rules.trigger: 题目包含“As shown in the diagram”且选项或答案包含具体系数时
experience_rules.check_logic: 检查是否已从图表中提取顶点坐标（如 P0, 2P0, V0, 2V0）并代入热力学第一定律公式，而非仅保留字母符号。

experience_rules.topic: Thermodynamics / Thermodynamic Processes (Isothermal, Adiabatic, etc.)
experience_rules.title: 球体绝热压缩幂律校验
experience_rules.trigger: 涉及球体体积变化且明确为绝热过程（neglect heat loss）时
experience_rules.check_logic: 利用 TV^(γ-1)=const，代入 V∝r^3，校验指数是否满足 T ∝ r^(-3(γ-1)) 或 T ∝ r^(3-3γ)

topics.topic: Work Done by Gases and PV Diagrams

top_down_rules.title: Verify work done using W = ∫PdV
top_down_rules.description: The work done by a gas in a thermodynamic process is calculated as the integral of pressure with respect to volume (W = ∫PdV). This equation applies when pressure is a function of volume or is constant during a process.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the work done is calculated as W = ∫P(V)dV when pressure depends on volume, or W = P * ΔV when pressure is constant. Verify that correct integration limits are used in each case.
common_errors: Using incorrect limits for the volume integral.
Assuming constant pressure in processes where pressure varies.
Neglecting the integral when pressure is not constant.

top_down_rules.title: Check sign convention for work done by the gas
top_down_rules.description: The sign convention for work in thermodynamics states that work done by the gas on the surroundings is positive, while work done on the gas is negative. This is crucial for correctly interpreting PV diagrams.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that work is positive when the gas expands (ΔV > 0) and negative when the gas compresses (ΔV < 0). Confirm the correct application of sign conventions in calculations.
common_errors: Reversing the sign convention for expansion and compression.
Confusing work done by the gas with work done on the gas.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure work corresponds to area under PV curve
top_down_rules.description: On a PV diagram, the work done by the gas during a process is represented by the area under the curve between the initial and final volumes.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the calculated work matches the geometrical area under the PV curve for the given process. Confirm correct interpretation of the curve's shape and limits.
common_errors: Incorrectly calculating area under the curve (e.g., forgetting to account for curve shape).
Using wrong limits for the area calculation.
Failing to include contributions from all segments of a multi-step process.

top_down_rules.title: Verify dimensional consistency of work done
top_down_rules.description: The work done by a gas has the units of energy (e.g., joules in SI units). This arises because pressure has units of force per unit area, and volume has units of length cubed.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the product of pressure (P, in Pa) and volume change (ΔV, in m³) has the resulting unit of energy (J). Verify that calculations involve consistent units.
common_errors: Using incorrect units for pressure or volume.
Neglecting to convert pressure or volume into consistent units before multiplication.

top_down_rules.title: Validate work done in isothermal processes
top_down_rules.description: For an isothermal process (constant temperature, ideal gas), the work done is W = nRT ln(V_f / V_i), where n is the number of moles, R is the ideal gas constant, T is the temperature, and V_f and V_i are the final and initial volumes.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the work is calculated using W = nRT ln(V_f / V_i) for isothermal processes and ensure temperature remains constant throughout. Validate the formula usage and volume ratio order.
common_errors: Using incorrect formula for work in isothermal processes.
Not verifying that temperature remains constant.
Using incorrect limits for volume ratio (e.g., V_f / V_i).

top_down_rules.title: Validate work done in adiabatic processes
top_down_rules.description: For an adiabatic process (no heat exchange), the work done is related to the pressure, volume, and specific heat ratio (γ). The formula is W = (P_fV_f - P_iV_i) / (1 - γ) or equivalent forms.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure the correct formula for work in adiabatic processes is used and verify that Q = 0 (no heat transfer). Confirm correct use of the specific heat ratio γ.
common_errors: Using the wrong formula for adiabatic work.
Failing to check that the process is adiabatic (Q ≠ 0).
Incorrectly applying γ (specific heat ratio) for the gas.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure net work done in a cyclic process equals enclosed area
top_down_rules.description: In a cyclic process (closed loop on a PV diagram), the net work done by the gas is equal to the area enclosed by the loop, with the sign depending on the direction of the cycle (clockwise or counterclockwise).
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the net work matches the geometrical area enclosed by the cycle and verify the direction of the cycle is correctly interpreted (clockwise = positive, counterclockwise = negative). Ensure proper identification of cycle direction in problem context.
common_errors: Incorrectly calculating the enclosed area.
Failing to account for the direction of the loop (clockwise = positive, counterclockwise = negative).
Mixing up processes within the cycle.

top_down_rules.title: Verify boundary conditions for work calculations
top_down_rules.description: Boundary conditions such as initial and final volumes, pressures, or temperatures must be consistent with the given process to correctly calculate work.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure all initial and final state variables used in work calculations match the problem statement or given PV diagram. Validate state conditions are checked and consistent.
common_errors: Using incorrect or inconsistent boundary conditions.
Failing to check for state variable consistency in multi-step processes.
Neglecting changes in state variables due to heat exchange or additional forces.

top_down_rules.title: Verify transitivity of thermal equilibrium
top_down_rules.description: The Zeroth Law of Thermodynamics states that if two systems (A and B) are each in thermal equilibrium with a third system (C), then they are in thermal equilibrium with each other. This principle underlies the concept of temperature as a measurable quantity.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that if T_A = T_C and T_B = T_C, then T_A = T_B for all systems being compared. Explicitly verify the equality of temperatures for all pairs.
common_errors: Failing to check the transitive relationship between three systems.
Assuming thermal equilibrium without explicitly stating it for all pairs.

top_down_rules.title: Check correctness of temperature scale conversions
top_down_rules.description: Temperature scales (e.g., Celsius, Kelvin, Fahrenheit) follow specific conversion formulas. Kelvin is the absolute scale and starts from absolute zero. For example, T(K) = T(°C) + 273.15 and T(°F) = (9/5)T(°C) + 32.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Validate that the correct conversion formula is applied for the given temperature scales. Ensure intermediate steps are shown for clarity.
common_errors: Incorrect addition/subtraction for Kelvin and Celsius conversion.
Forgetting to multiply by (9/5) or add 32 for Fahrenheit conversion.
Mixing up units (e.g., treating Kelvin as Celsius).

top_down_rules.title: Ensure dimensional and unit consistency for temperature
top_down_rules.description: Temperature must be expressed in consistent units when used in equations or comparisons. For example, Kelvin should be used in thermodynamic equations involving absolute temperatures.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that temperature units are consistent throughout the solution, particularly in equations like PV = nRT or when calculating efficiency. Ensure conversions are performed where necessary.
common_errors: Using Celsius instead of Kelvin in thermodynamic equations.
Treating different temperature units as directly comparable without conversion.
Mixing Kelvin and Rankine scales without conversion.

top_down_rules.title: Verify validity conditions for applying the Zeroth Law
top_down_rules.description: The Zeroth Law applies only to systems that can exchange heat and are isolated from external influences. Ensure no external work or heat source disrupts equilibrium.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Confirm that systems are thermally isolated from external heat sources and that no additional work is being done on the systems. Verify that heat exchange is possible between the systems.
common_errors: Ignoring external heat sources or work being done on the system.
Applying the Zeroth Law to systems not capable of heat exchange.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure proper thermometer calibration
top_down_rules.description: Thermometers must be calibrated to a known temperature scale (e.g., freezing and boiling points of water at 1 atm) to ensure accurate measurement. Calibration errors invalidate temperature readings.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Check if the thermometer is calibrated correctly based on the problem's given temperature scale (Celsius, Kelvin, etc.). Verify reference points like freezing and boiling points, and account for atmospheric pressure if relevant.
common_errors: Using uncalibrated thermometers in calculations.
Assuming perfect calibration without verification of reference points.
Forgetting to account for atmospheric pressure when using boiling/freezing points.

top_down_rules.title: Define and identify thermal equilibrium correctly
top_down_rules.description: Thermal equilibrium occurs when two or more systems in thermal contact have no net heat flow between them, meaning their temperatures are equal.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Ensure that the system's temperature equality is explicitly stated when claiming thermal equilibrium. Verify that no net heat flow occurs between the systems.
common_errors: Claiming thermal equilibrium without verifying equal temperatures.
Confusing thermal equilibrium with mechanical or chemical equilibrium.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure Zeroth Law is applied only to macroscopic systems
top_down_rules.description: The Zeroth Law is a macroscopic principle and does not apply to quantum or microscopic systems where temperature may not be well-defined.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that the systems being analyzed are macroscopic and can be described by a well-defined temperature. Ensure the systems are in equilibrium states.
common_errors: Attempting to apply the Zeroth Law to microscopic or quantum systems.
Assuming temperature is meaningful for non-equilibrium states.

top_down_rules.title: Ensure temperature is defined as a state variable
top_down_rules.description: Temperature is a state variable that depends only on the state of the system and not on the path taken to reach that state. Ensure the solution treats temperature as a property of equilibrium states.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Confirm that temperature is treated as a uniform and state-dependent property in the solution. Verify that it is not influenced by the process path.
common_errors: Treating temperature as path-dependent.
Failing to recognize temperature as uniform in equilibrium conditions.

top_down_rules.title: Account for uncertainty in temperature measurements
top_down_rules.description: Temperature measurements are subject to uncertainties due to instrument precision, calibration, and environmental factors. These uncertainties must be considered in calculations and conclusions.
top_down_rules.check_logic: Verify that uncertainties in temperature measurements are accounted for, especially when they impact significant figures or derived quantities.
common_errors: Ignoring measurement uncertainties in calculations.
Overstating the precision of temperature readings.
Failing to propagate uncertainties in derived quantities.
